nodes.proof:
Suppose that the assertion is false. Then

\[
\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} + 2{b}^{\frac{5}{4}}\operatorname{scal}\left( \widehat{S}\right)  =  - 2
\]

for some pair of orthonormal vectors \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2}}\right\} \) . We may assume that \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2}}\right\} \) are eigenvectors of \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( \widehat{S}\right) \) , and \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} \geq  \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} \) . Let us extend \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2}}\right\} \) to an eigenbasis \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},\ldots ,{e}_{n}}\right\} \) of \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( \widehat{S}\right) \) . Clearly, \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{pp} \geq  \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} \) for \( 3 \leq  p \leq  n \) . For each \( t \in  \left\lbrack  {0,\widehat{t}}\right\rbrack \) , we define \( S\left( t\right)  \mathrel{\text{ := }} {l}_{a, b}^{-1}\left( {R\left( t\right) }\right) \) . Since condition (ii) holds up to time \( \widehat{t} \) , we know that

\[
\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\left( t\right) \right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\left( t\right) \right) }_{22} + 2{b}^{\frac{5}{4}}\operatorname{scal}\left( {S\left( t\right) }\right)  \geq   - 2
\]

for all \( t \in  \left\lbrack  {0,\widehat{t}}\right\rbrack \) . The evolution of \( S\left( t\right) \) is given by \( {\left. \frac{d}{dt}S\left( t\right) \right| }_{t = \widehat{t}} = Q\left( \widehat{S}\right)  + {D}_{a, b}\left( \widehat{S}\right) \) . Using the formula for \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( {{D}_{a, b}\left( \widehat{S}\right) }\right) \) , we obtain

\[
0 \geq  {\left. \frac{1}{2}\frac{d}{dt}\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\left( t\right) \right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\left( t\right) \right) }_{22} + 2{b}^{\frac{5}{4}}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\left( t\right) \right) \right) \right| }_{t = \widehat{t}}
\]

\[
\geq  \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 1}}^{n}\left( {{\widehat{S}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{S}}_{2p2p}}\right) \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{pp}
\]

\[
+ \frac{3}{2}{b}^{\frac{5}{4}}{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( \widehat{S}\right) \right| }^{2} - {2b}\left( {{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }^{2}\right) }_{11} + {\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }^{2}\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{4}{n}\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( \widehat{S}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

\[
= \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\widehat{S}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{S}}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{pp} - \frac{1}{2}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22}}\right) }\right)  + \frac{3}{2}{b}^{\frac{5}{4}}{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( \widehat{S}\right) \right| }^{2}
\]

\[
+ \frac{1}{2}\left( {1 - {2b}}\right) {\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22}\right) }^{2} - b{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
+ \frac{4}{n}\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( \widehat{S}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

if \( b \geq  0 \) is sufficiently small. Note that \( {\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( \widehat{S}\right) \right| }^{2} \geq  \frac{1}{n}\operatorname{scal}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }^{2} \) . Hence, if \( b \geq  0 \) is sufficiently small, then

\[
\frac{1}{2}{b}^{\frac{5}{4}}{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( \widehat{S}\right) \right| }^{2} + \frac{1}{2}\left( {1 - {2b}}\right) {\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
>  - \frac{4}{n}\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( \widehat{S}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

by Young's inequality. This gives

\[
0 \geq  {\left. \frac{1}{2}\frac{d}{dt}\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\left( t\right) \right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\left( t\right) \right) }_{22} + 2{b}^{\frac{5}{4}}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\left( t\right) \right) \right) \right| }_{t = \widehat{t}}
\]

\[
> \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\widehat{S}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{S}}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{pp} - \frac{1}{2}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22}}\right) }\right)
\]

\[
+ {b}^{\frac{5}{4}}{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( \widehat{S}\right) \right| }^{2} - b{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11}\right) }^{2}.
\]

At this point, we distinguish two cases:

Case 1: Suppose first that \( {\widehat{S}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{S}}_{2p2p} \geq  0 \) for all \( p \in  \{ 3,\ldots , n\} \) . In this case,

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\widehat{S}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{S}}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{pp} - \frac{1}{2}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22}}\right) }\right)
\]

\[
\geq  \frac{1}{2}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\widehat{S}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{S}}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11}}\right)
\]

hence

\[
0 \geq  {\left. \frac{1}{2}\frac{d}{dt}\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\left( t\right) \right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\left( t\right) \right) }_{22} + 2{b}^{\frac{5}{4}}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\left( t\right) \right) \right) \right| }_{t = \widehat{t}}
\]

\[
> \frac{1}{2}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\widehat{S}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{S}}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11}}\right)
\]

\[
+ {b}^{\frac{5}{4}}{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( \widehat{S}\right) \right| }^{2} - b{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11}\right) }^{2}
\]

If \( b = 0 \) or \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} \leq  {b}^{\frac{1}{8}}\left| {\operatorname{Ric}\left( \widehat{S}\right) }\right| \) or \( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\widehat{S}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{S}}_{2p2p}}\right)  \geq \; {2b}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11}}\right) \) , then the right-hand side is nonnegative and we arrive at a contradiction. Therefore, we must have \( b > 0 \) and \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} \geq \; {b}^{\frac{1}{8}}\left| {\operatorname{Ric}\left( \widehat{S}\right) }\right| \) and \( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\widehat{S}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{S}}_{2p2p}}\right)  \leq  {2b}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11}}\right) \) . Since \( \left| {\widehat{R} - \widehat{S}}\right| \; \leq  C\left( n\right) b\operatorname{scal}\left( \widehat{R}\right) \) , it follows that \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{R}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{R}\right) }_{11} \geq  c\left( n\right) {b}^{\frac{1}{8}}\operatorname{scal}\left( \widehat{R}\right) \) and \( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\widehat{R}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{R}}_{2p2p}}\right)  \leq  C\left( n\right) b\operatorname{scal}\left( \widehat{R}\right) \) . On the other hand, using Lemma 2.4, we obtain

\[
{\widehat{R}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{R}}_{2p2p} + {\widehat{R}}_{1q1q} + {\widehat{R}}_{2q2q}
\]

\[
\geq  c\left( n\right) {b}^{\frac{1}{4}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( \widehat{R}\right) }^{-3}{\left( \left| {\widehat{R}}_{1p1p}\right|  + \left| {\widehat{R}}_{2p2p}\right|  + \left| {\widehat{R}}_{1q1q}\right|  + \left| {\widehat{R}}_{2q2q}\right| \right) }^{4}
\]

for \( 3 \leq  p < q \leq  n \) . Summation over \( p \) and \( q \) gives

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\widehat{R}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{R}}_{2p2p}}\right)  \geq  c\left( n\right) {b}^{\frac{1}{4}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( \widehat{R}\right) }^{-3}{\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( \left| {\widehat{R}}_{1p1p}\right|  + \left| {\widehat{R}}_{2p2p}\right| \right) \right) }^{4}
\]

\[
\geq  c\left( n\right) {b}^{\frac{1}{4}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( \widehat{R}\right) }^{-3}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{R}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{R}\right) }_{11}\right) }^{4}
\]

\[
\geq  c\left( n\right) {b}^{\frac{3}{4}}\operatorname{scal}\left( \widehat{R}\right) .
\]

This contradicts the inequality \( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\widehat{R}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{R}}_{2p2p}}\right)  \leq  C\left( n\right) b\operatorname{scal}\left( \widehat{R}\right) \) if \( b \) is sufficiently small.

Case 2: Suppose next that \( {\widehat{S}}_{1m1m} + {\widehat{S}}_{2m2m} < 0 \) for some \( m \in  \{ 3,\ldots , n\} \) . Since \( \widehat{S} \in \) PIC, Lemma A. 3 implies that each eigenvalue of \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( \widehat{S}\right) \) is bounded from above by the sum of all the other eigenvalues. Therefore,

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p \in  \{ 1,\ldots , n\} \smallsetminus \{ m\} }}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{pp} \geq  \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{mm}.
\]

Since \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} \leq  0 \) , it follows that

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p \in  \{ 3,\ldots , n\} \smallsetminus \{ m\} }}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{pp} - \frac{1}{2}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22}}\right) }\right)
\]

\[
\geq  \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{mm} - \frac{1}{2}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22}}\right) .
\]

This implies

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\widehat{S}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{S}}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{pp} - \frac{1}{2}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22}}\right) }\right)
\]

\[
\geq  \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p \in  \{ 3,\ldots , n\} \smallsetminus \{ m\} }}\left( {{\widehat{S}}_{1m1m} + {\widehat{S}}_{2m2m} + {\widehat{S}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{S}}_{2p2p}}\right)
\]

\[
\cdot  \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{pp} - \frac{1}{2}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22}}\right) }\right)
\]

\[
\geq  \frac{1}{2}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p \in  \{ 3,\ldots , n\} \smallsetminus \{ m\} }}\left( {{\widehat{S}}_{1m1m} + {\widehat{S}}_{2m2m} + {\widehat{S}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{S}}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11}}\right) ,
\]

hence

\[
0 \geq  {\left. \frac{1}{2}\frac{d}{dt}\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\left( t\right) \right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\left( t\right) \right) }_{22} + 2{b}^{\frac{5}{4}}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\left( t\right) \right) \right) \right| }_{t = \widehat{t}}
\]

\[
> \frac{1}{2}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p \in  \{ 3,\ldots , n\} \smallsetminus \{ m\} }}\left( {{\widehat{S}}_{1m1m} + {\widehat{S}}_{2m2m} + {\widehat{S}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{S}}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11}}\right)
\]

\[
+ {b}^{\frac{5}{4}}{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( \widehat{S}\right) \right| }^{2} - b{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11}\right) }^{2}.
\]

If \( b = 0 \) or \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} \leq  {b}^{\frac{1}{8}}\left| {\operatorname{Ric}\left( \widehat{S}\right) }\right| \) or

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p \in  \{ 3,\ldots , n\} \smallsetminus \{ m\} }}\left( {{\widehat{S}}_{1m1m} + {\widehat{S}}_{2m2m} + {\widehat{S}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{S}}_{2p2p}}\right)  \geq  {2b}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11}}\right) ,
\]

then the right-hand side is nonnegative, and we arrive at a contradiction. Therefore, we must have \( b > 0 \) and \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11} \geq  {b}^{\frac{1}{8}}\left| {\operatorname{Ric}\left( \widehat{S}\right) }\right| \) and

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p \in  \{ 3,\ldots , n\} \smallsetminus \{ m\} }}\left( {{\widehat{S}}_{1m1m} + {\widehat{S}}_{2m2m} + {\widehat{S}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{S}}_{2p2p}}\right)  \leq  {2b}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{S}\right) }_{11}}\right) .
\]

Since \( \left| {\widehat{R} - \widehat{S}}\right|  \leq  C\left( n\right) b\operatorname{scal}\left( \widehat{R}\right) \) , it follows that

\[
\operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{R}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{R}\right) }_{11} \geq  c\left( n\right) {b}^{\frac{1}{8}}\operatorname{scal}\left( \widehat{R}\right)
\]

and

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p \in  \{ 3,\ldots , n\} \smallsetminus \{ m\} }}\left( {{\widehat{R}}_{1m1m} + {\widehat{R}}_{2m2m} + {\widehat{R}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{R}}_{2p2p}}\right)  \leq  C\left( n\right) b\operatorname{scal}\left( \widehat{R}\right) .
\]

On the other hand, using Lemma 2.4, we obtain

\[
{\widehat{R}}_{1m1m} + {\widehat{R}}_{2m2m} + {\widehat{R}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{R}}_{2p2p}
\]

\[
\operatorname{geqc}\left( n\right) {b}^{\frac{1}{4}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( \widehat{R}\right) }^{-3}{\left( \left| {\widehat{R}}_{1m1m}\right|  + \left| {\widehat{R}}_{2m2m}\right|  + \left| {\widehat{R}}_{1p1p}\right|  + \left| {\widehat{R}}_{2p2p}\right| \right) }^{4}
\]

for \( p \in  \{ 3,\ldots , n\}  \smallsetminus  \{ m\} \) . Summation over \( p \in  \{ 3,\ldots , n\}  \smallsetminus  \{ m\} \) gives

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p \in  \{ 3,\ldots , n\} \smallsetminus \{ m\} }}\left( {{\widehat{R}}_{1m1m} + {\widehat{R}}_{2m2m} + {\widehat{R}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{R}}_{2p2p}}\right)
\]

\[
\geq  c\left( n\right) {b}^{\frac{1}{4}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( \widehat{R}\right) }^{-3}{\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( \left| {\widehat{R}}_{1p1p}\right|  + \left| {\widehat{R}}_{2p2p}\right| \right) \right) }^{4}
\]

\[
\geq  c\left( n\right) {b}^{\frac{1}{4}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( \widehat{R}\right) }^{-3}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{R}\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( \widehat{R}\right) }_{11}\right) }^{4}
\]

\[
\geq  c\left( n\right) {b}^{\frac{3}{4}}\operatorname{scal}\left( \widehat{R}\right) .
\]

This contradicts the inequality

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p \in  \{ 3,\ldots , n\} \smallsetminus \{ m\} }}\left( {{\widehat{R}}_{1m1m} + {\widehat{R}}_{2m2m} + {\widehat{R}}_{1p1p} + {\widehat{R}}_{2p2p}}\right)  \leq  C\left( n\right) b\operatorname{scal}\left( \widehat{R}\right)
\]

if \( b \) is sufficiently small.

nodes.proof:
Suppose that

\[
{\widehat{R}}_{1313} + {\widehat{R}}_{1414} + {\widehat{R}}_{2323} + {\widehat{R}}_{2424} - 2{\widehat{R}}_{1234}
\]

\[
= {\delta }^{\frac{1}{4}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( \widehat{R}\right) }^{-3}{\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( {\widehat{R}}_{13pq} - {\widehat{R}}_{24pq}\right) }^{2} + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( {\widehat{R}}_{14pq} + {\widehat{R}}_{23pq}\right) }^{2}\right) }^{2}
\]

for some orthonormal frame \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},\ldots ,{e}_{n}}\right\} \) . In view of condition (iii), the left-hand side of the equation is strictly positive. We now argue as in Section 7.3 of [5]. Lemmas 7.8, 7.10, and 7.12 in [5] hold with error terms that are bounded by \( C\left( n\right) {\delta }^{\frac{1}{4}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( \widehat{R}\right) }^{-1}\left( {\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( {\widehat{R}}_{13pq} - {\widehat{R}}_{24pq}\right) }^{2} + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}\left( {{\widehat{R}}_{14pq} + }\right. }\right. \; \left. {\left. {\widehat{R}}_{23pq}\right) }^{2}\right) \) . Consequently, Lemmas 7.9,7.11, and 7.13 in [5] hold with error terms that are bounded by \( C\left( n\right) {\delta }^{\frac{1}{4}}\left( {\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( {\widehat{R}}_{13pq} - {\widehat{R}}_{24pq}\right) }^{2} + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( {\widehat{R}}_{14pq} + {\widehat{R}}_{23pq}\right) }^{2}}\right) \) .

Putting these facts together, we obtain an inequality of the form

\[
{\left( {\widehat{R}}^{\# }\right) }_{1313} + {\left( {\widehat{R}}^{\# }\right) }_{1414} + {\left( {\widehat{R}}^{\# }\right) }_{2323} + {\left( {\widehat{R}}^{\# }\right) }_{2424} + 2{\left( {\widehat{R}}^{\# }\right) }_{1342} + 2{\left( {\widehat{R}}^{\# }\right) }_{1423}
\]

\[
\geq   - C\left( n\right) {\delta }^{\frac{1}{4}}\left( {\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( {\widehat{R}}_{13pq} - {\widehat{R}}_{24pq}\right) }^{2} + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( {\widehat{R}}_{14pq} + {\widehat{R}}_{23pq}\right) }^{2}}\right) .
\]

This implies

\[
{\left. \frac{d}{dt}\left( R{\left( t\right) }_{1313} + R{\left( t\right) }_{1414} + R{\left( t\right) }_{2323} + R{\left( t\right) }_{2424} - 2R{\left( t\right) }_{1234}\right) \right| }_{t = \widehat{t}}
\]

\[
= {\left( {\widehat{R}}^{2}\right) }_{1313} + {\left( {\widehat{R}}^{2}\right) }_{1414} + {\left( {\widehat{R}}^{2}\right) }_{2323} + {\left( {\widehat{R}}^{2}\right) }_{2424} + 2{\left( {\widehat{R}}^{2}\right) }_{1342} + 2{\left( {\widehat{R}}^{2}\right) }_{1423}
\]

\[
+ {\left( {\widehat{R}}^{\# }\right) }_{1313} + {\left( {\widehat{R}}^{\# }\right) }_{1414} + {\left( {\widehat{R}}^{\# }\right) }_{2323} + {\left( {\widehat{R}}^{\# }\right) }_{2424} + 2{\left( {\widehat{R}}^{\# }\right) }_{1342} + 2{\left( {\widehat{R}}^{\# }\right) }_{1423}
\]

\[
\geq  \left( {1 - C\left( n\right) {\delta }^{\frac{1}{4}}}\right) \left( {\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( {\widehat{R}}_{13pq} - {\widehat{R}}_{24pq}\right) }^{2} + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( {\widehat{R}}_{14pq} + {\widehat{R}}_{23pq}\right) }^{2}}\right) .
\]

On the other hand, since the norm of \( \widehat{R} \) is controlled by \( \operatorname{scal}\left( \widehat{R}\right) \) , we obtain

\[
{\left. \frac{d}{dt}\left\lbrack  \operatorname{scal}{\left( R\left( t\right) \right) }^{-3}{\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( R{\left( t\right) }_{13pq} - R{\left( t\right) }_{24pq}\right) }^{2} + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( R{\left( t\right) }_{14pq} + R{\left( t\right) }_{23pq}\right) }^{2}\right) }^{2}\right\rbrack  \right| }_{t = \widehat{t}}
\]

\[
\leq  C\left( n\right) \left( {\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( {\widehat{R}}_{13pq} - {\widehat{R}}_{24pq}\right) }^{2} + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( {\widehat{R}}_{14pq} + {\widehat{R}}_{23pq}\right) }^{2}}\right) .
\]

Thus, we conclude that

\[
\frac{d}{dt}\left\lbrack  {R{\left( t\right) }_{1313} + R{\left( t\right) }_{1414} + R{\left( t\right) }_{2323} + R{\left( t\right) }_{2424} - {2R}{\left( t\right) }_{1234}}\right.
\]

\[
- {\left. {\delta }^{\frac{1}{4}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( R\left( t\right) \right) }^{-3}\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( R{\left( t\right) }_{13pq} - R{\left( t\right) }_{24pq}\right) }^{2} + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( R{\left( t\right) }_{14pq} + R{\left( t\right) }_{23pq}\right) }^{2}\right) \right| }_{t = \widehat{t}}
\]

\[
\geq  \left( {1 - C\left( n\right) {\delta }^{\frac{1}{4}}}\right) \left( {\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( {\widehat{R}}_{13pq} - {\widehat{R}}_{24pq}\right) }^{2} + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( {\widehat{R}}_{14pq} + {\widehat{R}}_{23pq}\right) }^{2}}\right) .
\]

If we choose \( \delta  > 0 \) sufficiently small, then the right-hand side is strictly positive. Hence, if \( t \in  \lbrack 0,\widehat{t}) \) is sufficiently close to \( \widehat{t} \) , then

\[
R{\left( t\right) }_{1313} + R{\left( t\right) }_{1414} + R{\left( t\right) }_{2323} + R{\left( t\right) }_{2424} - {2R}{\left( t\right) }_{1234}
\]

\[
< {\delta }^{\frac{1}{4}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( R\left( t\right) \right) }^{-3}\left( {\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( R{\left( t\right) }_{13pq} - R{\left( t\right) }_{24pq}\right) }^{2} + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{\left( R{\left( t\right) }_{14pq} + R{\left( t\right) }_{23pq}\right) }^{2}}\right) .
\]

This contradicts the fact that condition (iv) holds up to time \( \widehat{t} \) .

Suppose that \( R \in  {\mathcal{G}}_{t}^{\left( 0\right) } \) . By definition, we may write \( R = {\ell }_{a, b}\left( S\right) \) , where \( b = \delta {e}^{-{8t}},{2a} = {2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2}, S \in \) PIC, and \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} + \; 2{b}^{\frac{5}{4}}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right)  \geq   - 2 \) . Since \( S \in \) PIC, Lemma A. 4 implies \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \oslash \) id \( \in \) PIC. Consequently,

\[
R - \frac{\left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2}}{2n}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \mathrm{{id}} \otimes  \mathrm{{id}} = S + b\operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \otimes  \mathrm{{id}} \in  \mathrm{{PIC}}.
\]

Moreover,

\[
{\operatorname{Ric}}_{11} + {\operatorname{Ric}}_{22} = \left( {1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{2}{n}\left( {{nb} + \left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right)
\]

\[
\geq  \left\lbrack  {\frac{2}{n}\left( {{nb} + \left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2}}\right)  - 2\left( {1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\right) {b}^{\frac{5}{4}}}\right\rbrack  \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right)
\]

\[
- 2\left( {1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\right) \text{ . }
\]

From this, the assertion follows.

Definition 3.1. For \( 0 < b \leq  {b}_{\max } \) as above, let \( \mathcal{E}\left( b\right) \) denote the set of all curvature tensors \( S \) for which there exists a tensor \( T \) satisfying the following conditions:

(iii) \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} + \frac{2\gamma }{n}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right)  \geq  0 \) .

(iv) For every orthonormal frame \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},\ldots ,{e}_{n}}\right\} \) , the following inequality holds:

\[
\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} \leq  {\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{\frac{1}{2}}{\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}\right) \right) }^{\frac{1}{2}}
\]

\[
+ 2\left( {n - 2}\right) b\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right) .
\]

Moreover, we define \( \mathcal{C}\left( b\right)  = {\ell }_{a, b}\left( {\mathcal{E}\left( b\right) }\right) \) .

nodes.proof:
We begin with an elementary lemma:

Lemma 3.3. Let \( n \geq  {12} \) , let \( 0 < b \leq  {b}_{\max } \) , and let a and \( \omega \) be defined as above. Then

\[
2 + \left( {n - 8}\right) b - 2\left( {n + 2}\right) \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} - n{\left( n - 2\right) }^{2}{b}^{3} > 0
\]

and

\[
\left( {\frac{n - 2}{n - 3} + \frac{2\left( {n - 2}\right) }{n}\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right)  + 8\left( {n - 3}\right) {b}^{2}}\right) \left( {\frac{n - 2}{n - 3} + 2\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right) }\right)  \leq  \frac{\omega }{2}.
\]

Proof. Note that \( 2 - 2\left( {n + 2}\right) \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} \geq  0 \) and \( \left( {n - 8}\right) b - n{\left( n - 2\right) }^{2}{b}^{3} \geq  0 \) . If we add these inequalities, the first statement follows.

To prove the second statement, we observe that

\[
\frac{2 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}{{\left( 2 + \left( n - 3\right) b\right) }^{2}} \geq  \frac{1}{2 + {nb}} \geq  \frac{4}{9}.
\]

This implies

\[
\omega  = {\left( 1 - 4\left( n - 2\right) {b}^{2}\right) }^{2}\left( {\frac{1}{nb} + \frac{n - 2}{n}}\right) \sqrt{\frac{27}{8}\frac{2 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}{{\left( 2 + \left( n - 3\right) b\right) }^{2}}}
\]

\[
\geq  {\left( 1 - \frac{n - 2}{4{n}^{2}}\right) }^{2}\frac{{5n} - 2}{n}\sqrt{\frac{3}{2}}.
\]

On the other hand, we have \( a = \frac{{\left( 2 + \left( n - 2\right) b\right) }^{2}}{2\left( {2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b}\right) }b \leq  \frac{2 + {nb}}{2}b \leq  \frac{9}{8}b \) . This implies \( {2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a \leq  {na} \leq  \frac{9n}{8}b \leq  \frac{9}{32} \) , which gives

\[
\frac{n - 2}{n - 3} + \frac{2\left( {n - 2}\right) }{n}\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right)  + 8\left( {n - 3}\right) {b}^{2} \leq  \frac{n - 2}{n - 3} + \frac{9\left( {n - 2}\right) }{16n} + \frac{n - 3}{2{n}^{2}}
\]

and

\[
\frac{n - 2}{n - 3} + 2\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right)  \leq  \frac{n - 2}{n - 3} + \frac{9}{16}.
\]

It is elementary to verify that

\[
\left( {\frac{n - 2}{n - 3} + \frac{9\left( {n - 2}\right) }{16n} + \frac{n - 3}{2{n}^{2}}}\right) \left( {\frac{n - 2}{n - 3} + \frac{9}{16}}\right)  \leq  {\left( 1 - \frac{n - 2}{4{n}^{2}}\right) }^{2}\frac{{5n} - 2}{n}\sqrt{\frac{3}{8}}
\]

for \( n \geq  {12} \) . This proves the assertion.

LEMMA 3.4. Let \( 0 < b \leq  {b}_{\max } \) , and let a be defined as above. Then

\[
\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} - {2a}}\right) {xy} + {2a}\left( {x + 2}\right) \left( {y + 2}\right)  + {b}^{2}\left( {{x}^{2} + {y}^{2}}\right)  \geq  0
\]

whenever \( x, y \geq   - \frac{2\left( {2 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\right) }{2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b} \) .

Proof. Let \( D = \left\{  {\left( {x, y}\right)  \in  {\mathbb{R}}^{2} : x, y \geq   - \frac{2\left( {2 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\right) }{2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b}}\right\} \) , and define \( \psi  : D \rightarrow  \mathbb{R} \) by \( \psi \left( {x, y}\right)  = \left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} - {2a}}\right) {xy} + {2a}\left( {x + 2}\right) \left( {y + 2}\right)  + {b}^{2}\left( {{x}^{2} + {y}^{2}}\right) \) . Clearly, \( \psi \left( {x, y}\right)  \rightarrow  \infty \) as \( \left( {x, y}\right)  \in  D \) approaches infinity. Hence, there exists a point in \( D \) where \( \psi \) attains its minimum. The Hessian of \( \psi \) is given by

\[
\left\lbrack  \begin{matrix} 2{b}^{2} & {2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} \\  {2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} & 2{b}^{2} \end{matrix}\right\rbrack  .
\]

Since the Hessian of \( \psi \) has two eigenvalues of opposite signs, the function \( \psi \) attains its minimum on the boundary of \( D \) . On the other hand, a straightforward calculation gives

\[
\psi \left( {-\frac{2\left( {2 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\right) }{2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b}, y}\right)  = {b}^{2}{y}^{2} \geq  0.
\]

Thus, \( \psi  \geq  0 \) on \( \partial D \) . This implies \( \psi  \geq  0 \) on \( D \) .

Lemma 3.5. Suppose that \( S \in  \mathcal{E}\left( b\right) \) . Then \( \left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} - {2a}}\right) \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }\left( S\right) \varnothing \; \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  + {2a}\operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \oslash  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  + 2{b}^{2}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }^{2} \oslash  \mathrm{{id}} \in \) PIC.

Proof. Let

\[
U \mathrel{\text{ := }} \left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} - {2a}}\right) \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }\left( S\right)  \oslash  \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }\left( S\right)  + {2a}\operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \oslash  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  + 2{b}^{2}\mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }{\left( S\right) }^{2} \oslash  \mathrm{{id}}.
\]

Let \( \zeta ,\eta  \in  {\mathbb{C}}^{n} \) be linearly independent vectors satisfying \( g\left( {\zeta ,\zeta }\right)  = g\left( {\zeta ,\eta }\right)  = \; g\left( {\eta ,\eta }\right)  = 0 \) . We claim that \( U\left( {\zeta ,\eta ,\bar{\zeta },\bar{\eta }}\right)  \geq  0 \) . We can find vectors \( z, w \in \; \operatorname{span}\{ \zeta ,\eta \} \) such that \( g\left( {z,\bar{z}}\right)  = g\left( {w,\bar{w}}\right)  = 2, g\left( {z,\bar{w}}\right)  = 0 \) , and \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \left( {z,\bar{w}}\right)  = 0 \) . The identities \( g\left( {\zeta ,\zeta }\right)  = g\left( {\zeta ,\eta }\right)  = g\left( {\eta ,\eta }\right)  = 0 \) give \( g\left( {z, z}\right)  = g\left( {z, w}\right)  = g\left( {w, w}\right) \; = 0 \) . Consequently, we may write \( z = {e}_{1} + i{e}_{2} \) and \( w = {e}_{3} + i{e}_{4} \) for some orthonormal four-frame \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2},{e}_{3},{e}_{4}}\right\}   \subset  {\mathbb{R}}^{n} \) . Using the identity \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \left( {z,\bar{w}}\right)  = 0 \) , we obtain

\[
U\left( {z, w,\bar{z},\bar{w}}\right)
\]

\[
= 2\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} - {2a}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{33} + {\operatorname{Ric}}_{44}}\right)
\]

\[
+ {4a}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{33} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{44}}\right)
\]

\[
+ 4{b}^{2}\left( {{\left( \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }{\left( S\right) }^{2}\right) }_{11} + {\left( \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }{\left( S\right) }^{2}\right) }_{22} + {\left( \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }{\left( S\right) }^{2}\right) }_{33} + {\left( \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }{\left( S\right) }^{2}\right) }_{44}}\right)
\]

\[
\geq  2\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} - {2a}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{33} + {\operatorname{Ric}}_{44}}\right)
\]

\[
+ {4a}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{33} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{44}}\right)
\]

\[
+ 2{b}^{2}\left( {{\left( \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{\mathrm{o}}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{\mathrm{o}}{\left( S\right) }_{22}\right) }^{2} + {\left( \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{\mathrm{o}}{\left( S\right) }_{33} + \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{\mathrm{o}}{\left( S\right) }_{44}\right) }^{2}}\right)
\]

\[
= \frac{2\operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{2}}{{n}^{2}}\left\lbrack  {\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} - {2a}}\right) {xy} + {2a}\left( {x + 2}\right) \left( {y + 2}\right)  + {b}^{2}\left( {{x}^{2} + {y}^{2}}\right) }\right\rbrack  ,
\]

where \( x \) and \( y \) are defined by \( x \mathrel{\text{ := }} \frac{n}{\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) }\left( {{\operatorname{Ric}}_{S}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + {\operatorname{Ric}}_{S}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) \) and \( y \mathrel{\text{ := }} \; \frac{n}{\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) }\left( {{\mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }}_{3}{\left( S\right) }_{33} + {\mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }}_{3}{\left( S\right) }_{44}}\right) \) . Condition (iii) implies that \( x, y \geq   - {2\gamma } - 2 = \; - \frac{2\left( {2 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\right) }{2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b} \) . Using Lemma 3.4, we obtain \( U\left( {z, w,\bar{z},\bar{w}}\right)  \geq  0 \) . Since \( \operatorname{span}\{ \zeta ,\eta \} \; = \operatorname{span}\{ z, w\} \) , it follows that \( U\left( {\zeta ,\eta ,\bar{\zeta },\bar{\eta }}\right)  \geq  0 \) . Thus, \( U \in \) PIC, as claimed.

LemMA 3.6. Suppose that \( S \in  \mathcal{E}\left( b\right)  \smallsetminus  \{ 0\} \) . Then \( {D}_{a, b}\left( S\right) \) lies in the interior of the PIC cone.

Proof. If \( {\left| \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }\left( S\right) \right| }^{2} = 0 \) , the assertion is trivial. If \( {\left| \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }\left( S\right) \right| }^{2} > 0 \) , the assertion follows from Lemma 3.5, taking into account the fact that

\[
n{b}^{2}\left( {1 - {2b}}\right)  - 2\left( {a - b}\right) \left( {1 - {2b} + n{b}^{2}}\right)
\]

\[
= \frac{{b}^{2}}{2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b}\left( {2 + \left( {n - 8}\right) b - 2\left( {n + 2}\right) \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} - n{\left( n - 2\right) }^{2}{b}^{3}}\right)  > 0
\]

for \( 0 < b \leq  {b}_{\max } \) .

After these preparations, we now give the proof of Theorem 3.2. It suffices to show that the cone \( \mathcal{E}\left( b\right) \) is transversally invariant under the ODE \( \frac{d}{dt}S = \; Q\left( S\right)  + {D}_{a, b}\left( S\right) \) for each \( 0 < b \leq  {b}_{\max } \) . By Lemma 3.6, we can find a small positive number \( \varepsilon \) (depending on \( b \) ) such that \( {D}_{a, b}\left( S\right)  - {2\varepsilon }\operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{2}\mathrm{{id}} \oslash  \mathrm{{id}} \in \) PIC for all \( S \in  \mathcal{E}\left( b\right) \) . We evolve \( T \) by the ODE \( \frac{d}{dt}T = {S}^{2} + \varepsilon \operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{2} \) id \( \oslash \) id.

Lemma 3.7. Suppose that \( S \in  \mathcal{E}\left( b\right)  \smallsetminus  \{ 0\} , T \geq  0 \) , and \( S - T \in \) PIC. Then \( \frac{d}{dt}T > 0. \)

Proof. This follows immediately from the evolution equation for \( T \) .

LEMMA 3.8. Suppose that \( S \in  \mathcal{E}\left( b\right)  \smallsetminus  \{ 0\} , T \geq  0 \) , and \( S - T \in \) PIC. Then \( \frac{d}{dt}\left( {S - T}\right) \) lies in the interior of the tangent cone \( {T}_{S - T} \) PIC.

Proof. We compute \( \frac{d}{dt}\left( {S - T}\right)  = {S}^{\# } + {D}_{a, b}\left( S\right)  - \varepsilon \operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{2} \) id/oid. Applying Proposition A.9 with \( U \mathrel{\text{ := }} S - T \) , we conclude that \( {S}^{\# } \in  {T}_{S - T} \) PIC. Moreover, by our choice of \( \varepsilon ,{D}_{a, b}\left( S\right)  - \varepsilon \operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{2} \) id \( \oslash \) id lies in the interior of the PIC cone. Putting these facts together, the assertion follows.

LEMMA 3.9. Suppose that \( S \in  \mathcal{E}\left( b\right)  \smallsetminus  \{ 0\} \) and \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} + \; \frac{2\gamma }{n}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right)  = 0 \) for some pair of orthonormal vectors \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2}}\right\} \) . Then

\[
\frac{d}{dt}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} + \frac{2\gamma }{n}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) }\right)  > 0.
\]

Proof. We may assume \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2}}\right\} \) are eigenvectors of \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \) , and \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} \; \geq  \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} \) . Let us extend \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2}}\right\} \) to an eigenbasis \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},\ldots ,{e}_{n}}\right\} \) of \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \) . Clearly, \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp} \geq  \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} \) for \( 3 \leq  p \leq  n \) . We compute

\[
\frac{1}{2}\frac{d}{dt}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} + \frac{2\gamma }{n}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) }\right)
\]

\[
= \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 1}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2p2p}}\right) \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp} + \frac{4\left( {1 + \gamma }\right) }{{n}^{2}}\left( {a - b}\right) \operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
+ \frac{2\gamma }{n}\left( {1 - {2b}}\right) {\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2} - {2b}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}^{2} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}^{2}}\right)
\]

\[
+ 2\left( {1 + \gamma }\right) \frac{{n}^{2}{b}^{2} - 2\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {a - b}\right) \left( {1 - {2b}}\right) }{n\left( {1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a}\right) }{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2}
\]

\[
= \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp} - \frac{1}{2}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) }\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{4\left( {1 + \gamma }\right) }{{n}^{2}}\left( {a - b}\right) \operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{2} + \frac{{2\gamma }\left( {1 + \gamma }\right) }{{n}^{2}}\left( {1 - {2b}}\right) \operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
- b{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}\right) }^{2} + \frac{2\gamma }{n}\left( {1 - {2b}}\right) {\left| \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }\left( S\right) \right| }^{2}
\]

\[
+ 2\left( {1 + \gamma }\right) \frac{{n}^{2}{b}^{2} - 2\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {a - b}\right) \left( {1 - {2b}}\right) }{n\left( {1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a}\right) }{\left| \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }\left( S\right) \right| }^{2}.
\]

Using the identity

\[
2\left( {a - b}\right)  + \gamma \left( {1 - {2b}}\right)  = \frac{b{\left( 1 + \left( n - 2\right) b\right) }^{2}}{2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b}
\]

and the inequality

\[
{n}^{2}{b}^{2} - 2\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {a - b}\right) \left( {1 - {2b}}\right)
\]

\[

Proof. If \( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right)  = 0 \) , then the right-hand side is infinite, and the inequality is trivially true. nodes.proof:
Let \( D = \left\{  {\left( {x, y}\right)  \in  {\mathbb{R}}^{2} : x, y \geq   - \frac{2\left( {2 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\right) }{2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b}}\right\} \) , and define \( \psi  : D \rightarrow  \mathbb{R} \) by \( \psi \left( {x, y}\right)  = \left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} - {2a}}\right) {xy} + {2a}\left( {x + 2}\right) \left( {y + 2}\right)  + {b}^{2}\left( {{x}^{2} + {y}^{2}}\right) \) . Clearly, \( \psi \left( {x, y}\right)  \rightarrow  \infty \) as \( \left( {x, y}\right)  \in  D \) approaches infinity. Hence, there exists a point in \( D \) where \( \psi \) attains its minimum. The Hessian of \( \psi \) is given by

\[
\left\lbrack  \begin{matrix} 2{b}^{2} & {2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} \\  {2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} & 2{b}^{2} \end{matrix}\right\rbrack  .
\]

Since the Hessian of \( \psi \) has two eigenvalues of opposite signs, the function \( \psi \) attains its minimum on the boundary of \( D \) . On the other hand, a straightforward calculation gives

\[
\psi \left( {-\frac{2\left( {2 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\right) }{2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b}, y}\right)  = {b}^{2}{y}^{2} \geq  0.
\]

Thus, \( \psi  \geq  0 \) on \( \partial D \) . This implies \( \psi  \geq  0 \) on \( D \) .

nodes.proof:
Let

\[
U \mathrel{\text{ := }} \left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} - {2a}}\right) \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }\left( S\right)  \oslash  \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }\left( S\right)  + {2a}\operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \oslash  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  + 2{b}^{2}\mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }{\left( S\right) }^{2} \oslash  \mathrm{{id}}.
\]

Let \( \zeta ,\eta  \in  {\mathbb{C}}^{n} \) be linearly independent vectors satisfying \( g\left( {\zeta ,\zeta }\right)  = g\left( {\zeta ,\eta }\right)  = \; g\left( {\eta ,\eta }\right)  = 0 \) . We claim that \( U\left( {\zeta ,\eta ,\bar{\zeta },\bar{\eta }}\right)  \geq  0 \) . We can find vectors \( z, w \in \; \operatorname{span}\{ \zeta ,\eta \} \) such that \( g\left( {z,\bar{z}}\right)  = g\left( {w,\bar{w}}\right)  = 2, g\left( {z,\bar{w}}\right)  = 0 \) , and \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \left( {z,\bar{w}}\right)  = 0 \) . The identities \( g\left( {\zeta ,\zeta }\right)  = g\left( {\zeta ,\eta }\right)  = g\left( {\eta ,\eta }\right)  = 0 \) give \( g\left( {z, z}\right)  = g\left( {z, w}\right)  = g\left( {w, w}\right) \; = 0 \) . Consequently, we may write \( z = {e}_{1} + i{e}_{2} \) and \( w = {e}_{3} + i{e}_{4} \) for some orthonormal four-frame \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2},{e}_{3},{e}_{4}}\right\}   \subset  {\mathbb{R}}^{n} \) . Using the identity \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \left( {z,\bar{w}}\right)  = 0 \) , we obtain

\[
U\left( {z, w,\bar{z},\bar{w}}\right)
\]

\[
= 2\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} - {2a}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{33} + {\operatorname{Ric}}_{44}}\right)
\]

\[
+ {4a}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{33} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{44}}\right)
\]

\[
+ 4{b}^{2}\left( {{\left( \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }{\left( S\right) }^{2}\right) }_{11} + {\left( \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }{\left( S\right) }^{2}\right) }_{22} + {\left( \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }{\left( S\right) }^{2}\right) }_{33} + {\left( \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }{\left( S\right) }^{2}\right) }_{44}}\right)
\]

\[
\geq  2\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} - {2a}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{33} + {\operatorname{Ric}}_{44}}\right)
\]

\[
+ {4a}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{33} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{44}}\right)
\]

\[
+ 2{b}^{2}\left( {{\left( \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{\mathrm{o}}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{\mathrm{o}}{\left( S\right) }_{22}\right) }^{2} + {\left( \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{\mathrm{o}}{\left( S\right) }_{33} + \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{\mathrm{o}}{\left( S\right) }_{44}\right) }^{2}}\right)
\]

\[
= \frac{2\operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{2}}{{n}^{2}}\left\lbrack  {\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2} - {2a}}\right) {xy} + {2a}\left( {x + 2}\right) \left( {y + 2}\right)  + {b}^{2}\left( {{x}^{2} + {y}^{2}}\right) }\right\rbrack  ,
\]

where \( x \) and \( y \) are defined by \( x \mathrel{\text{ := }} \frac{n}{\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) }\left( {{\operatorname{Ric}}_{S}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + {\operatorname{Ric}}_{S}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) \) and \( y \mathrel{\text{ := }} \; \frac{n}{\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) }\left( {{\mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }}_{3}{\left( S\right) }_{33} + {\mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }}_{3}{\left( S\right) }_{44}}\right) \) . Condition (iii) implies that \( x, y \geq   - {2\gamma } - 2 = \; - \frac{2\left( {2 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\right) }{2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b} \) . Using Lemma 3.4, we obtain \( U\left( {z, w,\bar{z},\bar{w}}\right)  \geq  0 \) . Since \( \operatorname{span}\{ \zeta ,\eta \} \; = \operatorname{span}\{ z, w\} \) , it follows that \( U\left( {\zeta ,\eta ,\bar{\zeta },\bar{\eta }}\right)  \geq  0 \) . Thus, \( U \in \) PIC, as claimed.

\]

\[
- b{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}\right) }^{2} + \frac{2\gamma }{n}\left( {1 - {2b}}\right) {\left| \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }\left( S\right) \right| }^{2}
\]

\[
+ 2\left( {1 + \gamma }\right) \frac{{n}^{2}{b}^{2} - 2\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {a - b}\right) \left( {1 - {2b}}\right) }{n\left( {1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a}\right) }{\left| \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }\left( S\right) \right| }^{2}.
\]

Using the identity

\[
2\left( {a - b}\right)  + \gamma \left( {1 - {2b}}\right)  = \frac{b{\left( 1 + \left( n - 2\right) b\right) }^{2}}{2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b}
\]

and the inequality

\[
{n}^{2}{b}^{2} - 2\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {a - b}\right) \left( {1 - {2b}}\right)
\]

\[
= \frac{2{b}^{2}}{2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b}\left( {\left( {{2n} - 1}\right)  + \left( {{3n} - 2}\right) \left( {n - 2}\right) b + \left( {n - 1}\right) {\left( n - 2\right) }^{2}{b}^{2}}\right)  \geq  0,
\]

we obtain

\[
\frac{1}{2}\frac{d}{dt}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} + \frac{2\gamma }{n}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) }\right)
\]

\[
\geq  \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp} - \frac{1}{2}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) }\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{2\left( {1 + \gamma }\right) }{{n}^{2}}\frac{b{\left( 1 + \left( n - 2\right) b\right) }^{2}}{2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b}\operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{2} - b{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}\right) }^{2}.
\]

By Lemma A.3, each eigenvalue of \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \) is bounded from above by the sum of all the other eigenvalues. Therefore,

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p \in  \{ 1,\ldots , n\} \smallsetminus \{ m\} }}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp} \geq  \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{mm}.
\]

Since \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} \leq  0 \) , we deduce that

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p \in  \{ 3,\ldots , n\} \smallsetminus \{ m\} }}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp} - \frac{1}{2}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) }\right)
\]

\[
\geq  \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{mm} - \frac{1}{2}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

for each \( m \in  \{ 3,\ldots , n\} \) . Since \( S - T \in \) PIC, it follows that

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2p2p} - {T}_{1p1p} - {T}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp} - \frac{1}{2}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) }\right)  \geq  0.
\]

Since \( T \geq  0 \) , we know that \( {T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p} \geq  0 \) for \( 3 \leq  p \leq  n \) . This gives

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp} - \frac{1}{2}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) }\right)
\]

\[
\geq  \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp} - \frac{1}{2}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) }\right)
\]

\[
\geq  \frac{1}{2}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right) .
\]

Putting these facts together, we obtain

\[
\frac{1}{2}\frac{d}{dt}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} + \frac{2\gamma }{n}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) }\right)
\]

\[
\geq  \frac{1}{2}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{2\left( {1 + \gamma }\right) }{{n}^{2}}\frac{b{\left( 1 + \left( n - 2\right) b\right) }^{2}}{2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b}\operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{2} - b{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}\right) }^{2}.
\]

At this point, we distinguish two cases:

Case 1: Suppose that \( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right)  \geq  {2b}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right) \) . In this case, we clearly have

\[
\frac{1}{2}\frac{d}{dt}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} + \frac{2\gamma }{n}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) }\right)  > 0.
\]

Case 2: Suppose next that \( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right)  < {2b}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right) \) . In this case, condition (iv) gives

\[
\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}
\]

\[
\leq  {\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{\frac{1}{2}}{\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}\right) \right) }^{\frac{1}{2}} + 2\left( {n - 2}\right) b\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right)
\]

\[
< {\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{\frac{1}{2}}{\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}\right) \right) }^{\frac{1}{2}} + 4\left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right) .
\]

Consequently,

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right)  > \frac{{\left( 1 - 4\left( n - 2\right) {b}^{2}\right) }^{2}}{\omega }\frac{{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}\right) }^{2}}{\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) }.
\]

Using the elementary inequality \( {2x} + y \geq  3{\left( {x}^{2}y\right) }^{\frac{1}{3}} \) for \( x, y \geq  0 \) , we obtain

\[
\frac{{\left( 1 - 4\left( n - 2\right) {b}^{2}\right) }^{2}}{2\omega }\frac{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}\right) }{\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) }
\]

\[
+ \frac{2\left( {1 + \gamma }\right) }{{n}^{2}}\frac{b{\left( 1 + \left( n - 2\right) b\right) }^{2}}{2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b}\frac{\operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{2}}{{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}\right) }^{2}}
\]

\[
\geq  3{\left( \frac{{\left( 1 - 4\left( n - 2\right) {b}^{2}\right) }^{4}}{8{\omega }^{2}}\frac{1 + \gamma }{{n}^{2}}\frac{b{\left( 1 + \left( n - 2\right) b\right) }^{2}}{2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b}\right) }^{\frac{1}{3}}
\]

\[
= b
\]

where in the last step we have used the definitions of \( \gamma \) and \( \omega \) . Thus, we conclude that

\[
\frac{1}{2}\frac{d}{dt}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} + \frac{2\gamma }{n}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) }\right)
\]

\[
> \frac{{\left( 1 - 4\left( n - 2\right) {b}^{2}\right) }^{2}}{2\omega }\frac{{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}\right) }^{3}}{\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) }
\]

\[
+ \frac{2\left( {1 + \gamma }\right) }{{n}^{2}}\frac{b{\left( 1 + \left( n - 2\right) b\right) }^{2}}{2 + \left( {n - 3}\right) b}\operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{2} - b{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
\geq  0\text{ . }
\]

This proves the assertion.

Lemma 3.10. Suppose that \( S \in  \mathcal{E}\left( b\right)  \smallsetminus  \{ 0\} , T \geq  0 \) , and \( S - T \in \) PIC. Moreover, suppose that

\[
\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}
\]

\[
= {\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{\frac{1}{2}}{\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}\right) \right) }^{\frac{1}{2}} + 2\left( {n - 2}\right) b\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right) .
\]

Then

\[
\frac{d}{dt}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)
\]

\[
< \frac{d}{dt}\left\lbrack  {{\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{\frac{1}{2}}{\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}\right) \right) }^{\frac{1}{2}} + 2\left( {n - 2}\right) b\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right) }\right\rbrack  .
\]

nodes.proof:
If \( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right)  = 0 \) , then the right-hand side is infinite, and the inequality is trivially true. In the following, we assume that \( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + }\right. \; \left. {T}_{2p2p}\right)  > 0 \) . Clearly, \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} \geq  0 \) and \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{12} = 0 \) . Without loss of generality, we may assume that \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pq} = 0 \) for \( 3 \leq  p < q \leq  n \) . We may write

\[
\frac{d}{dt}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)  = {J}_{1} + {J}_{2} + {J}_{3} + {J}_{4} + {J}_{5} + {J}_{6},
\]

where

\[
{J}_{1} \mathrel{\text{ := }} 2\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{2p2p} - {S}_{1p1p}}\right) \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp}
\]

\[
{J}_{2} \mathrel{\text{ := }}  - 4\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{S}_{121p}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{2p}
\]

\[
{J}_{3} \mathrel{\text{ := }} 4\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{S}_{212p}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{1p}
\]

\[
{J}_{4} \mathrel{\text{ := }}  - 2{S}_{1212}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right) ,
\]

\[
{J}_{5} \mathrel{\text{ := }} {4b}\left( {{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }^{2}\right) }_{11} - {\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }^{2}\right) }_{22}}\right) ,
\]

\[
{J}_{6} \mathrel{\text{ := }} \frac{4}{n}\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right) .
\]

The terms \( {J}_{1},{J}_{2},{J}_{3} \) can be estimated by

\[
{J}_{1} \leq  \tau \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{2p2p} - {S}_{1p1p}\right) }^{2} + \frac{1}{\tau }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
{J}_{2} \leq  \frac{2\left( {n - 2}\right) \tau }{n - 3}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{121p}\right) }^{2} + \frac{2\left( {n - 3}\right) }{\left( {n - 2}\right) \tau }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{2p}\right) }^{2},
\]

\[
{J}_{3} \leq  \frac{2\left( {n - 2}\right) \tau }{n - 3}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{212p}\right) }^{2} + \frac{2\left( {n - 3}\right) }{\left( {n - 2}\right) \tau }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{1p}\right) }^{2},
\]

where \( \tau \) is an arbitrary positive number. To estimate \( {J}_{4} \) , we observe that

\[
0 \leq  \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{3 \leq  p, q \leq  n, p \neq  q}}\left( {{S}_{1212} + {S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2q2q} + {S}_{pqpq}}\right)
\]

\[
= \left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {n - 3}\right) {S}_{1212} + \left( {n - 4}\right) \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2p2p}}\right)  + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp}
\]

since \( S \in \) PIC. This gives

\[
{J}_{4} \leq  \frac{2\left( {n - 4}\right) }{\left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {n - 3}\right) }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{2}{\left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {n - 3}\right) }\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right) \left( {\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp}}\right)
\]

\[
= \frac{2\left( {n - 4}\right) }{\left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {n - 3}\right) }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2p2p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{2}{\left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {n - 3}\right) }\left( {\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{2p2p} - {S}_{1p1p}}\right) }\right) \left( {\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp}}\right) ,
\]

hence

\[
{J}_{4} \leq  \frac{\left( {n - 2}\right) \tau }{n - 3}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2p2p}\right) }^{2} + \frac{{\left( n - 4\right) }^{2}}{{\left( n - 2\right) }^{2}\left( {n - 3}\right) \tau }{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
+ \frac{\tau }{n - 3}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{2p2p} - {S}_{1p1p}\right) }^{2} + \frac{1}{\left( {n - 3}\right) \tau }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp}\right) }^{2}
\]

for each \( \tau  > 0 \) . Adding these inequalities gives

\[
{J}_{1} + {J}_{2} + {J}_{3} + {J}_{4}
\]

\[
\leq  \frac{2\left( {n - 2}\right) \tau }{n - 3}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}_{1p1p}\right) }^{2} + {\left( {S}_{2p2p}\right) }^{2} + {\left( {S}_{121p}\right) }^{2} + {\left( {S}_{212p}\right) }^{2}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{n - 2}{\left( {n - 3}\right) \tau }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp}\right) }^{2} + \frac{2\left( {n - 3}\right) }{\left( {n - 2}\right) \tau }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{1p}\right) }^{2} + {\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{2p}\right) }^{2}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{{\left( n - 4\right) }^{2}}{{\left( n - 2\right) }^{2}\left( {n - 3}\right) \tau }{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
\leq  \frac{\left( {n - 2}\right) \tau }{n - 3}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{1p1p} + {\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{2p2p}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{n - 2}{\left( {n - 3}\right) \tau }{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2} - \frac{n - 2}{2\left( {n - 3}\right) \tau }{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}\right) }^{2}
\]

for each \( \tau  > 0 \) . Moreover,

\[
{J}_{5} \leq   - {4b}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right)  + {4b}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{1p}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
=  - {4b}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{2p2p} - {S}_{1p1p}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

\[
+ {4b}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{12p2} + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{q = 3}}^{n}{S}_{1qpq}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
\leq  8\left( {n - 3}\right) {b}^{2}\tau \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{2p2p} - {S}_{1p1p}\right) }^{2} + \frac{n - 2}{2\left( {n - 3}\right) \tau }{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
+ 4\left( {n - 2}\right) b\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}_{12p2}\right) }^{2} + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{q = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{1qpq}\right) }^{2}}\right)
\]

\[
\leq  \left( {8\left( {n - 3}\right) {b}^{2}\tau  + 2\left( {n - 2}\right) b}\right) \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{1p1p} + {\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{2p2p}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{n - 2}{2\left( {n - 3}\right) \tau }{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}\right) }^{2}
\]

for each \( \tau  > 0 \) . Finally,

\[
{J}_{6} = \frac{4}{n}\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right) \left( {\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{2p2p} - {S}_{1p1p}}\right) }\right) \left( {\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 1}}^{n}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp}}\right)
\]

\[
\leq  \frac{2\left( {n - 2}\right) \tau }{n}\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right) \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{2p2p} - {S}_{1p1p}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
+ \frac{2\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right) }{\tau }{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2}
\]

\[
\leq  \frac{2\left( {n - 2}\right) \tau }{n}\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right) \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{1p1p} + {\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{2p2p}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{2\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right) }{\tau }{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2}
\]

for each \( \tau  > 0 \) . Putting these facts together, we obtain

\[
\frac{d}{dt}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)
\]

\[
\leq  \left\lbrack  {\left( {\frac{n - 2}{n - 3} + \frac{2\left( {n - 2}\right) }{n}\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right)  + 8\left( {n - 3}\right) {b}^{2}}\right) \tau  + 2\left( {n - 2}\right) b}\right\rbrack
\]

\[
\cdot  \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{1p1p} + {\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{2p2p}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \left( {\frac{n - 2}{n - 3} + 2\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right) }\right) \frac{1}{\tau }{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2}
\]

for each \( \tau  > 0 \) . If we put \( \tau  = {2\sigma }\left( {\frac{n - 2}{n - 3} + 2\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right) }\right) \) and use the inequality

\[

\]

> \left( {{\omega \sigma } + 2\left( {n - 2}\right) b}\right) \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{1p1p} + {\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{2p2p}}\right)  + \frac{1}{2\sigma }{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2},
\]

This implies

\[

\]

\[

\]

for \( n \geq  {13} \) . Moreover, it is straightforward to verify that the first inequality holds for \( n = {12} \) .

To prove the second statement, we observe that

\[

\]

This implies

\[
\frac{{a}_{\max } - {\widetilde{a}}_{\max }}{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) {\widetilde{a}}_{\max }} - \frac{{b}_{\max } - {\widetilde{b}}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {\widetilde{b}}_{\max }}

\]

\[
\geq  \frac{{a}_{\max } - \left( {1 + n{\widetilde{b}}_{\max }}\right) {b}_{\max }}{\left( {1 + n{\widetilde{b}}_{\max }}\right) \left( {1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {\widetilde{b}}_{\max }}\right) }
\]

\[
\geq  0
\]

for \( n \geq  {12} \) . From this, the second statement follows.

It remains to verify the third statement. Arguing as above, we obtain

\[
\frac{{a}_{\max } - {\widetilde{a}}_{\max }}{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) {\widetilde{a}}_{\max }} - \left( {1 + {\gamma }_{\max }}\right) \frac{{b}_{\max } - {\widetilde{b}}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {\widetilde{b}}_{\max }}
\]

\]

Using the identity \( {a}_{\max } = \left( {1 + \frac{n - 2}{2}{b}_{\max }}\right) \left( {1 + {\gamma }_{\max }}\right) {b}_{\max } \) and the inequality \( \frac{n - 2}{2}{b}_{\max } - n{\widetilde{b}}_{\max } \geq  \frac{n - 8}{8n}\left( {1 + n{\widetilde{b}}_{\max }}\right) \) for \( n \geq  {20} \) , we obtain

for \( n \geq  {20} \) . On the other hand, the inequality \( 2{\widetilde{a}}_{\max } \leq  3{\widetilde{b}}_{\max } = \frac{1}{{\left( n - 6\right) }^{2}} \) gives

nodes.content_excerpt: Proposition 4.3. Let \( {b}_{\max } \) and \( {\widetilde{b}}_{\max } \) be defined as above. Then \( \widetilde{\mathcal{C}}\left( {\widetilde{b}}_{\max }\right) = \; \mathcal{C}\left( {b}_{\max }\right) \) .

nodes.proof:
The inclusion \( \widetilde{\mathcal{C}}\left( {\widetilde{b}}_{\max }\right)  \subset  \mathcal{C}\left( {b}_{\max }\right) \) follows immediately from the definition. We now prove the reverse inclusion \( \mathcal{C}\left( {b}_{\max }\right)  \subset  \widetilde{\mathcal{C}}\left( {\widetilde{b}}_{\max }\right) \) . For abbreviation, we put \( b = {\widetilde{b}}_{\max } \) and \( a = {\widetilde{a}}_{\max } \) . Moreover, suppose that \( S \) is an algebraic curvature tensor such that \( {\ell }_{a, b}\left( S\right)  \in  \mathcal{C}\left( {b}_{\max }\right) \) . We claim that \( S \in  \widetilde{\mathcal{E}}\left( b\right) \) . To verify this claim, we need to show that

\[
Z \mathrel{\text{ := }} {S}_{1313} + {\lambda }^{2}{S}_{1414} + {S}_{2323} + {\lambda }^{2}{S}_{2424} - {2\lambda }{S}_{1234}
\]

\[
+ \sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right)  \geq  0
\]

for every orthonormal four-frame \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2},{e}_{3},{e}_{4}}\right\} \) and every \( \lambda  \in  \left\lbrack  {0,1}\right\rbrack \) . To prove this, we consider the algebraic curvature tensor \( T = {\ell }_{{a}_{\max },{b}_{\max }}^{-1}\left( {{\ell }_{a, b}\left( S\right) }\right)  \in \; \mathcal{E}\left( {b}_{\max }\right) \) . Clearly, \( T \in \) PIC and \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} + \frac{2{\gamma }_{\max }}{n}\operatorname{scal}\left( T\right)  \geq  0 \) .

Note that \( S \) and \( T \) have the same Weyl tensor. Moreover, \( \mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }\left( S\right)  = \; \frac{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\mathop{\operatorname{Ric}}\limits^{ \circ  }\left( T\right) \) and \( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right)  = \frac{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) {a}_{\max }}{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a}\operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) \) . This gives

\[
\operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  = \frac{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\operatorname{Ric}\left( T\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{1}{n}\left( {\frac{2\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {{a}_{\max } - a}\right) }{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{\left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {{b}_{\max } - b}\right) }{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) \text{ id }
\]

and

\[
S = T + \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\operatorname{Ric}\left( T\right)  \oslash  \mathrm{{id}}
\]

\[
+ \frac{1}{n}\left( {\frac{{a}_{\max } - a}{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) \operatorname{id} \oslash  \operatorname{id}.
\]

Consequently,

\[
Z = {T}_{1313} + {\lambda }^{2}{T}_{1414} + {T}_{2323} + {\lambda }^{2}{T}_{2424} - {2\lambda }{T}_{1234}
\]

\[
+ \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\left\lbrack  {\left( {1 + {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \left( {1 + {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22}}\right.
\]

\[
\left. {+2\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{33} + 2{\lambda }^{2}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{44}}\right\rbrack
\]

\[
+ \frac{4}{n}\left( {\frac{{a}_{\max } - a}{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \left( {1 + {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{2}{n}\left( {\frac{2\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {{a}_{\max } - a}\right) }{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{\left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {{b}_{\max } - b}\right) }{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) .
\]

Using Lemma A.6, we obtain

\[
Z \geq   - \frac{1 - {\lambda }^{2}}{n - 4}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} - 2{T}_{1212}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\left\lbrack  {\left( {1 + {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \left( {1 + {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22}}\right.
\]

\[
\left. {+2\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{33} + 2{\lambda }^{2}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{44}}\right\rbrack
\]

\[
+ \frac{4}{n}\left( {\frac{{a}_{\max } - a}{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \left( {1 + {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{2}{n}\left( {\frac{2\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {{a}_{\max } - a}\right) }{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{\left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {{b}_{\max } - b}\right) }{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right)
\]

\[
=  : \text{ RHS. }
\]

We claim that RHS \( \geq  0 \) for all \( \lambda  \in  \left\lbrack  {0,1}\right\rbrack \) . Since RHS is a linear function of \( {\lambda }^{2} \) , it suffices to examine the endpoints of the interval:

Case 1: Suppose first that \( \lambda  = 1 \) . In this case,

\[
\mathrm{{RHS}} = 2\frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\left\lbrack  {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{33} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{44}}\right\rbrack
\]

\[
+ \frac{8}{n}\left( {\frac{{a}_{\max } - a}{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) .
\]

Using Lemma A.4, \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{33} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{44} \geq  0 \) . Using Lemma 4.2, we conclude that \( \mathrm{{RHS}} \geq  0 \) .

Case 2: Suppose next that \( \lambda  = 0 \) . Recall that

\[
\frac{1}{n - 4} \leq  \frac{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\sqrt{2a}\frac{{n}^{2} - {7n} + {14}}{{n}^{2} - {5n} + 4}
\]

by Lemma 4.2. Using the inequalities

\[
\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} - 2{T}_{1212} \geq  0
\]

and

\[
\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} + 2\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{33}
\]

\[
= \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{33}}\right)  + \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{33}}\right)  \geq   - \frac{4{\gamma }_{\max }}{n}\operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) ,
\]

we obtain

\[
\mathrm{{RHS}} \geq   - \frac{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\sqrt{2a}\frac{{n}^{2} - {7n} + {14}}{{n}^{2} - {5n} + 4}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} - 2{T}_{1212}}\right)
\]

\[
- \frac{4{\gamma }_{\max }}{n}\frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\operatorname{scal}\left( T\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{4}{n}\left( {\frac{{a}_{\max } - a}{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\sqrt{2a}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{2}{n}\left( {\frac{2\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {{a}_{\max } - a}\right) }{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{\left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {{b}_{\max } - b}\right) }{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \sqrt{2a}\operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) .
\]

Since \( T \in \) PIC, we can estimate the term \( {T}_{1212} \) in terms of \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} \) and \( \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) \) :

\[

\]

\[
= \left( {{n}^{2} - {7n} + {14}}\right) {T}_{1212} + \left( {n - 5}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22}}\right)  + \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) .
\]

This finally gives

\[
\mathrm{{RHS}} \geq   - \frac{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\frac{2\sqrt{2a}}{{n}^{2} - {5n} + 4}\operatorname{scal}\left( T\right)  - \frac{4{\gamma }_{\max }}{n}\frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\operatorname{scal}\left( T\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{4}{n}\left( {\frac{{a}_{\max } - a}{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{2}{n}\left( {\frac{2\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {{a}_{\max } - a}\right) }{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{\left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {{b}_{\max } - b}\right) }{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \sqrt{2a}\operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) .
\]

Using Lemma 4.2, we obtain RHS \( \geq  0 \) . This completes the proof of Proposition 4.3.
