Lemma 3.11 For any \( R \in  {S}^{2}\left( {\mathfrak{{so}}\left( n\right) }\right) \) , let \( {Ri}{c}_{11} \leq  {Ri}{c}_{22} \) be the two smallest eigenvalues for \( {Ric}\left( R\right) \) . We have

\[
{\left| Ri{c}_{0}\right| }^{2} \geq  \frac{n - 1}{n}{\left( Ri{c}_{22} - Ri{c}_{11}\right) }^{2}. \tag{3.6}
\]
nodes.content_excerpt: Lemma 3.11 For any \( R \in {S}^{2}\left( {\mathfrak{{so}}\left( n\right) }\right) \) , let \( {Ri}{c}_{11} \leq {Ri}{c}_{22} \) be the two smallest eigenvalues for \( {Ric}\left( R\right) \) . We have \[ {\left| Ri{c}_{0}\right| }^{2} \geq \frac{n - 1}{n}{\left( Ri{c}_{22} - Ri{c}_{11}\right) }^{2}. \tag{3.6} \]

nodes.proof:
We may assume \( {\lambda }_{1} \leq  {\lambda }_{2} \leq  \cdots  \leq  {\lambda }_{n} \) are eigenvalues for \( {Ric} \) , and \( \bar{\lambda } = \frac{scal}{n} = \frac{1}{n}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{i = 1}}^{n}{\lambda }_{i} \) . Then we have

\[
{\left| {\operatorname{Ric}}_{0}\right| }^{2} = \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{i = 1}}^{n}{\left( {\lambda }_{i} - \bar{\lambda }\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
\geq  {\left( {\lambda }_{1} - \bar{\lambda }\right) }^{2} + {\left( {\lambda }_{2} - \bar{\lambda }\right) }^{2} + \left( {n - 2}\right) {\left( \frac{\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{i = 3}}^{n}{\lambda }_{i}}{n - 2} - \bar{\lambda }\right) }^{2}.
\]

Now, if we replace \( R \) by \( R + c\mathrm{{id}} \land  \mathrm{{id}} \) for some real number \( c \) , then the two sides of 3.6 remain the same. By the homogeneity of the inequality, we can assume without loss of generality that \( {\lambda }_{1} =  - 1,{\lambda }_{2} = 0 \) . Denote \( \nu  = \frac{1}{n - 2}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{i = 3}}^{n}{\lambda }_{i} \) , then \( \nu  \geq  0 \) and \( \bar{\lambda } = \frac{1}{n}\left( {\left( {n - 2}\right) \nu  - 1}\right) \) , we calculate that

\[
{\left| Ri{c}_{0}\right| }^{2} \geq  \frac{{\left( \left( n - 2\right) \nu  + \left( n - 1\right) \right) }^{2}}{{n}^{2}} + \frac{{\left( \left( n - 2\right) \nu  - 1\right) }^{2}}{{n}^{2}} + \left( {n - 2}\right) \frac{{\left( 2\nu  + 1\right) }^{2}}{{n}^{2}}
\]

\[
= \frac{1}{{n}^{2}}\left( {{2n}\left( {n - 2}\right) {\nu }^{2} + {2n}\left( {n - 2}\right) \nu  + n\left( {n - 1}\right) }\right)
\]

\[
\geq  \frac{n - 1}{n}
\]

The assertion follows.

nodes.content:
Proposition 3.12 Suppose \( S \in  \mathcal{E}\left( b\right)  \smallsetminus  \{ 0\} , T \geq  0 \) and \( S - T \in  {C}_{PIC} \) . Moreover, suppose that

\[
\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} = {\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}{\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{\frac{1}{2}}{\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}\right) \right) }^{\frac{1}{2}},
\]

then

\[
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)  < \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left\lbrack  {{\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}{\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{\frac{1}{2}}{\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}\right) \right) }^{\frac{1}{2}}}\right\rbrack \tag{3.8}
\]
nodes.content_excerpt: Proposition 3.12 Suppose \( S \in \mathcal{E}\left( b\right) \smallsetminus \{ 0\} , T \geq 0 \) and \( S - T \in {C}_{PIC} \) . Moreover, suppose that \[ \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} = {\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}{\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{\frac{1}{2}}{\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}\right) \rig...

nodes.proof:
We assume \( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right)  > 0 \) (otherwise the right hand side of the desired inequality is infinity and the result is trivially true), clearly we have \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} \geq  0 \) and \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{12} = 0 \) . Without loss of generality, we may assume that \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pq} = 0 \) for \( 3 \leq  p < q \leq  n \) . As in [Bre19] we write

\[
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)  = {J}_{1} + {J}_{2} + {J}_{3} + {J}_{4} + {J}_{5} + {J}_{6},
\]

where the terms \( {J}_{1},\cdots ,{J}_{6} \) are defined by

\[
{J}_{1} = 2\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{2p2p} - {S}_{1p1p}}\right) \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp}
\]

\[
{J}_{2} =  - 4\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{S}_{121p}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{2p}
\]

\[
{J}_{3} = 4\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{S}_{212p}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{1p}
\]

\[
{J}_{4} =  - 2{S}_{1212}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right) ,
\]

\[
{J}_{5} = {4b}\left( {{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }^{2}\right) }_{11} - {\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }^{2}\right) }_{22}}\right) ,
\]

\[
{J}_{6} = \frac{4}{n}\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right) .
\]

It turns out that the terms \( {J}_{1} \) and \( {J}_{6} \) play a major role, and it’s more convenient to put the terms \( {J}_{4},{J}_{5},{J}_{6} \) together.

We estimate the terms \( {J}_{1},{J}_{2},{J}_{3} \) by

\[
{J}_{1} \leq  \tau \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{2p2p} - {S}_{1p1p}\right) }^{2} + \frac{1}{\tau }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp}\right) }^{2},
\]

\[
{J}_{2} \leq  {2\tau }\left( {1 + b\sqrt{n - 2}}\right) \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{121p}\right) }^{2} + \frac{2}{\tau \left( {1 + b\sqrt{n - 2}}\right) }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {\operatorname{Ric}}_{2p}\right) }^{2},
\]

\[
{J}_{3} \leq  {2\tau }\left( {1 + b\sqrt{n - 2}}\right) \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{212p}\right) }^{2} + \frac{2}{\tau \left( {1 + b\sqrt{n - 2}}\right) }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {\operatorname{Ric}}_{1p}\right) }^{2}.
\]

Notice that

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{3 \leq  p \neq  q \leq  n}}\left( {{S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{1q1q} + {S}_{2p2p} + {S}_{2q2q}}\right)  \geq  0,
\]

we obtain \( \mathrm{{Ric}}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \mathrm{{Ric}}{\left( S\right) }_{22} \geq  2{S}_{1212} \) . Combining this with the assumption that \( \mathrm{{Ric}}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \; \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} \geq  0 \) , the term \( {J}_{5} \) can be estimated by

\[
{J}_{5} \leq   - {4b}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right)  + {4b}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{1p}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
\leq   - {8b}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right) {S}_{1212} + {2b\tau }\left( {\frac{1}{\sqrt{n - 2}} + b}\right) \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{1p}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
+ \frac{2b}{\tau \left( {\frac{1}{\sqrt{n - 2}} + b}\right) }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{1p}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
=  - {8b}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right) {S}_{1212} + {2b\tau }\left( {\frac{1}{\sqrt{n - 2}} + b}\right) \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{12p2} + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{q = 3}}^{n}{S}_{1qpq}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
+ \frac{2b}{\tau \left( {\frac{1}{\sqrt{n - 2}} + b}\right) }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{1p}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
\leq   - {8b}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right) {S}_{1212} + 2\left( {n - 2}\right) {b\tau }\left( {\frac{1}{\sqrt{n - 2}} + b}\right) \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}_{12p2}\right) }^{2} + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{q = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{1qpq}\right) }^{2}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{2b}{\tau \left( {\frac{1}{\sqrt{n - 2}} + b}\right) }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{1p}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
\mathrel{\text{ := }}  - {8b}{S}_{1212}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)  + {J}_{7}.
\]

Notice that we have the inequality

\[
0 \leq  \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{3 \leq  p \neq  q \leq  n}}\left( {{S}_{1212} + {S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2q2q} + {S}_{pqpq}}\right)
\]

\[
= \left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {n - 3}\right) {S}_{1212} + \left( {n - 4}\right) \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2p2p}}\right)  + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp}
\]

\[
= \left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {n - 4}\right) {S}_{1212} + \left( {n - 5}\right) \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2p2p}}\right)  + \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) .
\]

This allows us to estimate \( {J}_{4} + {J}_{5} + {J}_{6} \) , as follows:

\[
{J}_{4} + {J}_{5} + {J}_{6}
\]

\[
\leq  \left( {\left( {-2 - {8b}}\right) {S}_{1212} + \frac{4}{n}\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) }\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)  + {J}_{7}
\]

\[
\leq  \left\lbrack  {\frac{\left( {2 + {8b}}\right) \left( {n - 5}\right) }{\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {n - 4}\right) }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2p2p}}\right)  + \left( {\frac{2 + {8b}}{\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {n - 4}\right) } + \frac{4}{n}\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right) }\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) }\right\rbrack
\]

\[
\cdot  \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)  + {J}_{7}
\]

\[
= \frac{\left( {2 + {8b}}\right) \left( {n - 5}\right) }{\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {n - 4}\right) }\left( {\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2p2p}}\right) }\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)
\]

\[
+ A\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \left( {\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{S}_{1p1p} - {S}_{2p2p}}\right) }\right)  + {J}_{7},
\]

where we recall that in the beginning of this section, we define \( A = \frac{2 + {8b}}{\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {n - 4}\right) } + \frac{4}{n}\left( {{2b} + \left( {n - 2}\right) a}\right) \) . Thus

\[
{J}_{4} + {J}_{5} + {J}_{6}
\]

\[
\leq  \left( {1 + \frac{A}{2}\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }}\right) \tau \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2p2p}\right) }^{2} + \frac{C}{\tau }{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
+ \frac{A\tau }{2}\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{2p2p} - {S}_{1p1p}\right) }^{2} + \frac{A}{2\tau }\sqrt{\frac{n - 2}{n}}{\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2} + {J}_{7},
\]

where

\[
C = \frac{{\left( 1 + 4b\right) }^{2}{\left( n - 5\right) }^{2}\left( {n - 2}\right) }{{\left( n - 1\right) }^{2}{\left( n - 4\right) }^{2}\left( {1 + \frac{A}{2}\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }}\right) } \leq  \frac{1 + {4b}}{n - 1} < \frac{1}{2}.
\]

Summing up, we have

\[
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)
\]

\[
\leq  \left( {1 + \frac{A}{2}\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }}\right) \tau \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{2p2p} - {S}_{1p1p}\right) }^{2} + \left( {1 + \frac{A}{2}\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }}\right) \tau \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{1p1p} + {S}_{2p2p}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
+ {2\tau }\left( {1 + b\sqrt{n - 2}}\right) \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{121p}\right) }^{2} + \left( {{2\tau }\left( {1 + b\sqrt{n - 2}}\right)  + 2\left( {n - 2}\right) {b\tau }\left( {\frac{1}{\sqrt{n - 2}} + b}\right) }\right) \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{212p}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
+ 2\left( {n - 2}\right) {b\tau }\left( {\frac{1}{\sqrt{n - 2}} + b}\right) \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{q = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{1qpq}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
+ \frac{1}{\tau }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp}\right) }^{2} + \frac{A}{2\tau }\sqrt{\frac{n - 2}{n}}{\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2} + \frac{1}{2\tau }{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}\right) }^{2}
\]

\[
+ \frac{2}{\tau \left( {1 + b\sqrt{n - 2}}\right) }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{2p}\right) }^{2} + \left( {\frac{2}{\tau \left( {1 + b\sqrt{n - 2}}\right) } + \frac{2b}{\tau \left( {\frac{1}{\sqrt{n - 2}} + b}\right) }}\right) \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{1p}\right) }^{2}.
\]

Notice that

\[
\frac{1}{1 + b\sqrt{n - 2}} + \frac{b}{\frac{1}{\sqrt{n - 2}} + b} = 1,
\]

and by Lemma 3.6, we have

\[
2\left( {1 + b\sqrt{n - 2}}\right)  + 2\left( {n - 2}\right) b\left( {\frac{1}{\sqrt{n - 2}} + b}\right)  = 2{\left( 1 + b\sqrt{n - 2}\right) }^{2} \leq  2 + A\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }.
\]

It follows that

\[
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)
\]

\[
\leq  \left( {2 + A\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }}\right) \tau \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}_{1p1p}\right) }^{2} + {\left( {S}_{2p2p}\right) }^{2} + {\left( {S}_{121p}\right) }^{2} + {\left( {S}_{212p}\right) }^{2} + \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{q = 3}}^{n}{\left( {S}_{1qpq}\right) }^{2}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{1}{\tau }\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{pp}\right) }^{2} + 2{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{1p}\right) }^{2} + 2{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{2p}\right) }^{2}}\right)  + \frac{1}{\tau }\left( {{\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}\right) }^{2} + {\left( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}\right) }^{2}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{A}{2\tau }\sqrt{\frac{n - 2}{n}}{\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2}
\]

\[
\leq  \left( {1 + \frac{A}{2}\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }}\right) \tau \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{1p1p} + {\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{2p2p}}\right)  + \frac{1}{\tau }{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2} + \frac{A}{2\tau }\sqrt{\frac{n - 2}{n}}{\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2},
\]

for any \( \tau  > 0 \) .

At this point, we make the following claim: Claim. We have for any \( \sigma  > 0 \) the estimate:

\[
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)  < \frac{{\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}\sigma }{2}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{1p1p} + {\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{2p2p}}\right)  + \frac{{\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}}{2\sigma }\left( {P{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2} + Q{\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2}}\right) .
\]

We shall distinguish 2 cases:

Case 1: If \( \frac{AP}{2}\sqrt{\frac{n - 2}{n}} - Q \geq  0 \) , we split the term containing \( {\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2} \) into two parts:

\[
\frac{A}{2\tau }\sqrt{\frac{n - 2}{n}} = \left( {\frac{AP}{2\left( {P + {nQ}}\right) \tau }\sqrt{\frac{n - 2}{n}} - \frac{Q}{\left( {P + {nQ}}\right) \tau }}\right)  + \left( {\frac{{AQ}\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }}{2\left( {P + {nQ}}\right) \tau } + \frac{Q}{\left( {P + {nQ}}\right) \tau }}\right) .
\]

Applying the inequality \( {\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2} \leq  n{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2} \) , we obtain

\[
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)
\]

\[
\leq  \left( {1 + \frac{A}{2}\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }}\right) \tau \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{1p1p} + {\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{2p2p}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \left( {\frac{{AP}\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }}{2\left( {P + {nQ}}\right) \tau } - \frac{nQ}{\left( {P + {nQ}}\right) \tau } + \frac{1}{\tau }}\right) {\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2}
\]

\[
+ \left( {\frac{{AQ}\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }}{2\left( {P + {nQ}}\right) \tau } + \frac{Q}{\left( {P + {nQ}}\right) \tau }}\right) {\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2}
\]

\[
= \left( {1 + \frac{A}{2}\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }}\right) \tau \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{1p1p} + {\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{2p2p}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \left( {1 + \frac{A}{2}\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }}\right) \frac{1}{\left( {P + {nQ}}\right) \tau }\left( {P{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2} + Q{\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2}}\right) .
\]

Recall that Lemma 3.6 shows that

\[
{\left( 1 + \frac{A}{2}\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }\right) }^{2}\frac{1}{P + {nQ}} < \frac{\omega }{4}.
\]

Thus, we have

\[
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)  < \frac{{\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}\sigma }{2}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{1p1p} + {\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{2p2p}}\right)  + \frac{{\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}}{2\sigma }\left( {P{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2} + Q{\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2}}\right) ,
\]

for any \( \sigma  > 0 \) , the claim is true.

Case 2: If otherwise \( \frac{AP}{2}\sqrt{\frac{n - 2}{n}} - Q < 0 \) , then

\[
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)
\]

\[
\leq  \left( {1 + \frac{A}{2}\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }}\right) \tau \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{1p1p} + {\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{2p2p}}\right)  + \frac{1}{\tau }{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2} + \frac{Q}{P\tau }{\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2}
\]

\[
= \left( {1 + \frac{A}{2}\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }}\right) \tau \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{1p1p} + {\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{2p2p}}\right)  + \frac{1}{P\tau }\left( {P{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2} + Q{\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2}}\right) .
\]

Recall that Lemma 3.6 shows that

\[
\left( {1 + \frac{A}{2}\sqrt{n\left( {n - 2}\right) }}\right) \frac{1}{P} < \frac{\omega }{4},
\]

thus for any \( \sigma  > 0 \) , we have

\[
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22} - \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11}}\right)  < \frac{{\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}\sigma }{2}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{1p1p} + {\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{2p2p}}\right)  + \frac{{\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}}{2\sigma }\left( {P{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2} + Q{\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2}}\right) ,
\]

also proves the claim.

Arriving here, combining the fact that \( \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left( {\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) }\right)  = P{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2} + Q{\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2} \) with the inequality

\[
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right)  > \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{1p1p} + {\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{2p2p}}\right) ,
\]

we are able to deduce that

\[
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left\lbrack  {{\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}{\operatorname{scal}}^{\frac{1}{2}}{\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}\right) \right) }^{\frac{1}{2}}}\right\rbrack
\]

\[
= \frac{1}{2}{\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{\frac{1}{2}}{\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}\right) \right) }^{-\frac{1}{2}}\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left( {\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right) }\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{1}{2}{\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}\operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{-\frac{1}{2}}{\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}\right) \right) }^{\frac{1}{2}}\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right)
\]

\[
> \frac{{\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}\sigma }{2}\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{1p1p} + {\left( {S}^{2}\right) }_{2p2p}}\right)  + \frac{{\omega }^{\frac{1}{2}}}{2\sigma }\left( {P{\left| \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right| }^{2} + Q{\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2}}\right) ,
\]

where we take \( \sigma  = \operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{\frac{1}{2}}{\left( \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}\right) \right) }^{-\frac{1}{2}} \) . Putting these facts together, the assertion follows.

The first and second statements are direct since

\[
n{b}^{2}\left( {1 - {2b}}\right)  - 2\left( {a - b}\right) \left( {1 - {2b} + n{b}^{2}}\right)  = {b}^{2}\left( {2 - {4b} - n\left( {n - 2}\right) {b}^{2}}\right)  \geq  0,
\]

and

\[
{n}^{2}{b}^{2} -  - 2\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {a - b}\right) \left( {1 - {2b}}\right)  = {b}^{2}\left( {{3n} - 2 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\right)  \geq  0.
\]

For the third and fourth statements, write \( {\widetilde{a}}_{\max } = {\widetilde{b}}_{\max } + \frac{n - 2}{2}{\widetilde{b}}_{\max } \) . Then \( \frac{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b} \leq  \frac{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) {\widetilde{a}}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {\widetilde{b}}_{\max }} \) , hence

\[
\zeta  \leq  {\zeta }_{\max } \mathrel{\text{ := }} \frac{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) {\widetilde{a}}_{\max }}{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) {a}_{\max }} \cdot  \frac{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {\widetilde{b}}_{\max }}\left( {1 + {\gamma }_{\max }}\right) .
\]

Now we have \( {\zeta }_{\max } \leq  1 \) and \( 1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {1 - {\zeta }_{\max }}\right)  \geq  2{\zeta }_{\max }^{2}\frac{{n}^{2} - {2n} + 2}{{\left( n - 2\right) }^{2}} \) for \( 9 \leq  n \leq  {11} \) , since

- For \( n = 9,{\zeta }_{\max } \approx  {0.824287} < 1 \) , and \( 1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {1 - {\zeta }_{\max }}\right)  - 2{\zeta }_{\max }^{2}\frac{{n}^{2} - {2n} + 2}{{\left( n - 2\right) }^{2}} \approx  {0.427367} > 0 \) ;

- For \( n = {10},{\zeta }_{\max } \approx  {0.822096} < 1 \) , and \( 1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {1 - {\zeta }_{\max }}\right)  - 2{\zeta }_{\max }^{2}\frac{{n}^{2} - {2n} + 2}{{\left( n - 2\right) }^{2}} \approx  {0.691388} > 0 \) ;

- For \( n = {11},{\zeta }_{\max } \approx  {0.820267} < 1 \) , and \( 1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {1 - {\zeta }_{\max }}\right)  - 2{\zeta }_{\max }^{2}\frac{{n}^{2} - {2n} + 2}{{\left( n - 2\right) }^{2}} \approx  {0.939657} > 0 \) ;

It follows that \( \zeta  \leq  1 \) and \( 1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {1 - \zeta }\right)  \geq  2{\zeta }^{2}\frac{{n}^{2} - {2n} + 2}{{\left( n - 2\right) }^{2}} \) .

nodes.proof:
We abbreviate that \( b = {\widetilde{b}}_{\max } \) and \( a = {\widetilde{a}}_{\max } \) . It is clear by definition that \( \widetilde{C}\left( b\right)  \subseteq  C\left( {b}_{\max }\right) \) , it suffices to show the other side of inclusion. To this end, we need to show that \( {l}_{a, b}^{-1}\left( {C\left( {b}_{\max }\right) }\right)  \in  \widetilde{\mathcal{E}}\left( b\right) \) . That is, for any algebraic curvature operator \( S \) satisfying \( {l}_{a, b}\left( S\right)  \in  C\left( {b}_{\max }\right) \) , we need to show that

\[
Z \mathrel{\text{ := }} {S}_{1313} + {\lambda }^{2}{S}_{1414} + {S}_{2323} + {\lambda }^{2}{S}_{2424} - {2\lambda }{S}_{1234} + \sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right)  \geq  0
\]

for every orthonormal four-frame \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2},{e}_{3},{e}_{4}}\right\} \) and every \( \lambda  \in  \left\lbrack  {0,1}\right\rbrack \) .

Let \( T = {l}_{{a}_{\max },{b}_{\max }}^{-1}\left( {{l}_{a, b}\left( S\right) }\right)  \in  \mathcal{E}\left( {b}_{\max }\right) \) , then by Definition 3.1, \( T \in  {C}_{PIC} \) and \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} + \; \frac{2{\gamma }_{\max }}{n}\operatorname{scal}\left( T\right)  \geq  0 \) . Then we have

\[
S = T + \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\operatorname{Ric}\left( T\right)  \land  \mathrm{{id}} + \frac{1}{n}\left( {\frac{{a}_{\max } - a}{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) \mathrm{{id}} \land  \mathrm{{id}}
\]

Hence

\[
Z = {T}_{1313} + {\lambda }^{2}{T}_{1414} + {T}_{2323} + {\lambda }^{2}{T}_{2424} - {2\lambda }{T}_{1234}
\]

\[
+ \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\left( {\left( {1 + {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \left( {1 + {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} + 2\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{33} + 2{\lambda }^{2}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{44}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{4}{n}\left( {\frac{{a}_{\max } - a}{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - {22}}\right) b}}\right) \left( {1 + {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{2}{n}\left( {\frac{2\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {{a}_{\max } - a}\right) }{1 + 2\left( {n - {11}}\right) a} - \frac{\left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {{b}_{\max } - b}\right) }{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) .
\]

Now, as \( T \in  {C}_{PIC} \) , consider the orthonormal four frame \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2},{e}_{3},\lambda {e}_{4} + \sqrt{1 - {\lambda }^{2}}{e}_{p}}\right\} \) for each \( 5 \leq  p \leq  n \) , we obtain

\[
{T}_{1313} + {\lambda }^{2}{T}_{1414} + {T}_{2323} + {\lambda }^{2}{T}_{2424} - {2\lambda }{T}_{1234} + \left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right)  \geq  0.
\]

Summing up the above equation over \( 5 \leq  p \leq  n \) and notice that

\[
\mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 5}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right)  \leq  \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p = 3}}^{n}\left( {{T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2p2p}}\right)  = \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} - 2{T}_{1313}, \tag{4.4}
\]

we obtain

\[
\left( {n - 4}\right) \left( {{T}_{1313} + {\lambda }^{2}{T}_{1414} + {T}_{2323} + {\lambda }^{2}{T}_{2424} - {2\lambda }{T}_{1234}}\right)  + \left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} - 2{T}_{1212}}\right)  \geq  0.
\]

Consequently, we have

\[
Z \geq   - \frac{1 - {\lambda }^{2}}{n - 4}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} - 2{T}_{1212}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{{b}_{max} - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\left( {\left( {1 + {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \left( {1 + {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} + 2\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{33} + 2{\lambda }^{2}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{44}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{4}{n}\left( {\frac{{a}_{\max } - a}{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - {22}}\right) b}}\right) \left( {1 + {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{2}{n}\left( {\frac{2\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {{a}_{\max } - a}\right) }{1 + 2\left( {n - {11}}\right) a} - \frac{\left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {{b}_{\max } - b}\right) }{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) .
\]

\[
=  : {RHS}\text{ . }
\]

We now show that \( {RHS} \geq  0 \) for all \( \lambda  \in  \left\lbrack  {0,1}\right\rbrack \) . Since \( {RHS} \) is a linear function of \( {\lambda }^{2} \) , we only need to verify the cases where \( \lambda  = 1 \) and \( \lambda  = 0 \) .

Case 1. Suppose first that \( \lambda  = 1 \) , then since \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{33} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{44} \geq  0 \) and \( \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right)  \geq  0 \) , we have

\[
{RHS} = 2\frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{33} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{44}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{8}{n}\left( {\frac{{a}_{\max } - a}{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) }\right)
\]

\[
\geq  0\text{ . }
\]

Case 2. Suppose then that \( \lambda  = 0 \) , by Lemma 4.2, we have

\[
\frac{1}{n - 4} \leq  \frac{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\sqrt{2a}\frac{{n}^{2} - {7n} + {14}}{{n}^{2} - {5n} + 4}.
\]

Using inequalities \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} - 2{T}_{1212} \geq  0 \) and

\[
\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} + 2\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{33} = \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{33}}\right)  + \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{33}}\right)  \geq   - \frac{4{\gamma }_{\max }}{n}\operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) ,
\]

we obtain

\[
{RHS} \geq   - \frac{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\sqrt{2a}\frac{{n}^{2} - {7n} + {14}}{{n}^{2} - {5n} + 4}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} - 2{T}_{1212}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\left( {\left( {1 + {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \left( {1 + {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} + 2\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{33} + 2{\lambda }^{2}\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{44}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{4}{n}\left( {\frac{{a}_{\max } - a}{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - {22}}\right) b}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\sqrt{2a}\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{2}{n}\left( {\frac{2\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {{a}_{\max } - a}\right) }{1 + 2\left( {n - {11}}\right) a} - \frac{\left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {{b}_{\max } - b}\right) }{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \sqrt{2a}\operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) .
\]

Notice that we can give a lower bound for the term \( {T}_{1212} \) in terms of \( \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22} \) and \( \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) \) , as follows:

\[
0 \leq  \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{3 \leq  p \neq  q \leq  n}}\left( {{T}_{1212} + {T}_{1p1p} + {T}_{2q2q} + {T}_{pqpq}}\right)
\]

\[
= \left( {{n}^{2} - {7n} + {14}}\right) {T}_{1212} + \left( {n - 5}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( T\right) }_{22}}\right)  + \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) .
\]

This gives

\[
{RHS} \geq   - \frac{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) {b}_{\max }}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}\frac{2\sqrt{2a}}{{n}^{2} - {5n} + 4}\operatorname{scal}\left( T\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{4}{n}\left( {\frac{{a}_{\max } - a}{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \left( {1 + {\gamma }_{\max }}\right) \frac{{b}_{\max } - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( T\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{2}{n}\left( {\frac{2\left( {n - 1}\right) \left( {{a}_{\max } - a}\right) }{1 + 2\left( {n - 1}\right) a} - \frac{\left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {b}_{\max }\right)  - b}{1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) b}}\right) \sqrt{2a}\operatorname{scal}\left( T\right) .
\]

Thus, \( {RHS} \geq  0 \) by Lemma 4.2.

nodes.proof:
It suffices to show that \( \widetilde{\mathcal{E}}\left( b\right) \) is transversally invariant under \( \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}S = Q\left( S\right)  + \; {D}_{a, b}\left( S\right) \) for each \( 0 < b \leq  {\widetilde{b}}_{\max } \) . Suppose \( S \in  \widetilde{\mathcal{E}}\left( b\right)  \smallsetminus  \{ 0\} \) , then

\[
Z \mathrel{\text{ := }} {S}_{1313} + {\lambda }^{2}{S}_{1414} + {S}_{2323} + {\lambda }^{2}{S}_{2424} - {2\lambda }{S}_{1234} + \sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right)  \geq  0
\]

for each orthonormal four-frame \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2},{e}_{3},{e}_{4}}\right\} \) and every \( \lambda  \in  \left\lbrack  {0,1}\right\rbrack \) .

To show the desired result, we assume \( Z = 0 \) for some orthonormal four-frame \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2},{e}_{3},{e}_{4}}\right\} \) and some \( \lambda  \in  \left\lbrack  {0,1}\right\rbrack \) . We distinguish two cases:

Case 1. Suppose that \( \lambda  \in  \lbrack 0,1) \) . Using the formula for \( {D}_{a, b}\left( S\right) \) in Section 2, we deduce that

\[
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}Z \geq  Q{\left( S\right) }_{1313} + {\lambda }^{2}Q{\left( S\right) }_{1414} + Q{\left( S\right) }_{2323} + {\lambda }^{2}Q{\left( S\right) }_{2424} - {2\lambda Q}{\left( S\right) }_{1234}
\]

\[
+ {2a}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{1313} + {2a}{\lambda }^{2}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{1414}
\]

\[
+ {2a}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{2323} + {2a}{\lambda }^{2}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{2424} - {4a\lambda }{\left( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{1234}
\]

\[
+ 2\sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \left( {{\left( S \star  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{11} + {\left( S \star  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

\[
+ \frac{4\left( {n - 2}\right) a}{n}\sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

\[
- {4b}\sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \left( {{\left( {\operatorname{Ric}}_{0}{\left( S\right) }^{2}\right) }_{11} + {\left( {\operatorname{Ric}}_{0}{\left( S\right) }^{2}\right) }_{22}}\right)  + \frac{8a}{{n}^{2}}\sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \operatorname{scal}{\left( S\right) }^{2}.
\]

Applying Lemma 4.8 with \( H = \sqrt{2a}\operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \) , we obtain

\[
Q{\left( S\right) }_{1313} + {\lambda }^{2}Q{\left( S\right) }_{1414} + Q{\left( S\right) }_{2323} + {\lambda }^{2}Q{\left( S\right) }_{2424} - {2\lambda Q}{\left( S\right) }_{1234}
\]

\[
+ {2a}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{1313} + {2a}{\lambda }^{2}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{1414}
\]

\[
+ {2a}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{2323} + {2a}{\lambda }^{2}{\left( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{2424} - {4a\lambda }{\left( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{1234}
\]

\[
+ 2\sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \left( {{\left( S \star  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{11} + {\left( S \star  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{22}}\right)  \geq  0.
\]

Since \( S \in  \widetilde{\mathcal{E}}\left( b\right)  \subset  {C}_{PIC} \) , we have that the largest eigenvalue of \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \) is bounded from above by \( \frac{1}{2}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \) . Moreover, by Lemma 4.4, the sum of the two smallest eigenvalues of \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \) is bounded from below by \( \frac{2\left( {1 - \zeta }\right) }{n}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \) . Applying Lemma 4.7 for \( H = \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \) and \( \rho  = \frac{b}{a} \) , we obtain

\[
\frac{\left( {n - 2}\right) a}{n}\operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right)  - b\left( {{\left( {\operatorname{Ric}}_{0}{\left( S\right) }^{2}\right) }_{11} + {\left( {\operatorname{Ric}}_{0}{\left( S\right) }^{2}\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

\[
\geq  \frac{2}{{n}^{2}}\left( {a\left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {1 - \zeta }\right)  - {2b}{\zeta }^{2}\frac{{n}^{2} - {2n} + 2}{{\left( n - 2\right) }^{2}}}\right) {\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2}.
\]

Putting these facts together, and notice that \( \left( {1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {1 - \zeta }\right) }\right)  > 2{\zeta }^{2}\frac{{n}^{2} - {2n} + 2}{{\left( n - 2\right) }^{2}} \) by Lemma 4.3, we conclude that

\[
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}Z \geq  \frac{8\sqrt{2a}\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) }{{n}^{2}}\left( {a\left( {1 + \left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {1 - \zeta }\right) }\right)  - {2b}{\zeta }^{2}\frac{{n}^{2} - {2n} + 2}{{\left( n - 2\right) }^{2}}}\right) {\left( \operatorname{scal}\left( S\right) \right) }^{2} > 0
\]

as \( \lambda  \in  \lbrack 0,1) \) .

Case 2. Suppose now that \( \lambda  = 1 \) , then we calculate that

\[
\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}Z = Q{\left( S\right) }_{1313} + Q{\left( S\right) }_{1414} + Q{\left( S\right) }_{2323} + Q{\left( S\right) }_{2424} - {2Q}{\left( S\right) }_{1234}
\]

\[
+ {2a}\left\lbrack  {{\left( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{1313} + {\left( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{1414}}\right.
\]

\[
+ {\left( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{2323} + {\left( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{2424} - 2{\left( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \right) }_{1234}\rbrack
\]

Since \( S \in  {C}_{PIC} \) and \( Z = {S}_{1313} + {S}_{1414} + {S}_{2323} + {S}_{2424} - {2Q}{\left( S\right) }_{1234} \geq  0 \) , noticing that the PIC condition is invariant under Hamiltonian ODE \( \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}S = Q\left( S\right) \) , we obtain

\[
Q{\left( S\right) }_{1313} + Q{\left( S\right) }_{1414} + Q{\left( S\right) }_{2323} + Q{\left( S\right) }_{2424} - {2Q}{\left( S\right) }_{1234} \geq  0.
\]

Now it suffices to show that the algebraic curvature operator \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \) lies in the interior of the cone \( {C}_{PIC} \) . To this end, let \( \zeta ,\eta  \in  {\mathbb{C}}^{n} \) be linearly independent complex vectors satisfying \( g\left( {\zeta ,\zeta }\right)  = g\left( {\zeta ,\eta }\right)  = g\left( {\eta ,\eta }\right)  = 0 \) , it suffices to show that \( \left( {\operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) }\right) \left( {\zeta ,\eta ,\bar{\zeta },\bar{\eta }}\right)  > 0 \) . As \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \) is unitarily diagonalizable on \( {\operatorname{span}}_{\mathbb{C}}\{ \eta ,\zeta \} \) , we can find \( z, w \in  {\operatorname{span}}_{\mathbb{C}}\{ \eta ,\zeta \} \) such that \( g\left( {z,\bar{z}}\right)  = g\left( {w,\bar{w}}\right)  = \; 2, g\left( {z,\bar{w}}\right)  = 0 \) and \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \left( {z,\bar{w}}\right)  = 0 \) . The identities \( g\left( {\zeta ,\zeta }\right)  = g\left( {\zeta ,\eta }\right)  = g\left( {\eta ,\eta }\right)  = 0 \) give \( g\left( {z, z}\right)  = \; g\left( {w, w}\right)  = g\left( {z, w}\right)  = 0 \) . Consequently, we may write \( z = {e}_{1} + i{e}_{2} \) and \( w = {e}_{3} + i{e}_{4} \) for some orthonormal four-frame \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2},{e}_{3},{e}_{4}}\right\}   \subset  {\mathbb{R}}^{n} \) . Using the identity \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \left( {z,\bar{w}}\right)  = 0 \) , and by Lemma we have that the sum of two smallest eigenvalues of \( \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) \) is strictly positive, we obtain

\[
\left( {\operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) }\right) \left( {z, w,\bar{z},\bar{w}}\right)  = 2\left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{11} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{22}}\right) \left( {\operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{33} + \operatorname{Ric}{\left( S\right) }_{44}}\right)  > 0.
\]

Since \( {\operatorname{span}}_{\mathbb{C}}\{ \eta ,\zeta \}  = {\operatorname{span}}_{\mathbb{C}}\{ z, w\} \) , we have \( \left( {\operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right)  \land  \operatorname{Ric}\left( S\right) }\right) \left( {\zeta ,\eta ,\bar{\zeta },\bar{\eta }}\right)  > 0 \) . Combining these facts together, we deduce that \( \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}Z > 0 \) .

Arriving here, we are finally able to prove Theorem 1.2.

Lemma 4.7 (Lemma A. 1 of [Bre19]) Let \( 0 \leq  \zeta  \leq  1 \) and \( 0 < \rho  \leq  1 \) . Assume that \( H \) is a symmetric bilinear form with the property that the largest eigenvalue of \( H \) is bounded from above by \( \frac{1}{2}\operatorname{tr}\left( H\right) \) and the sum of the two smallest eigenvalues of \( H \) is bounded from below by \( \frac{2\left( {1 - \zeta }\right) }{n}\operatorname{tr}\left( H\right) \) . Then

\[
\frac{n - 2}{n}\operatorname{tr}\left( H\right) \left( {{H}_{11} + {H}_{22}}\right)  - \rho \left( {{\left( {H}_{0}^{2}\right) }_{11} + {\left( {H}_{0}^{2}\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

\[
\geq  \frac{2}{{n}^{2}}\left( {\left( {n - 2}\right) \left( {1 - \zeta }\right)  - 2{\zeta }^{2}\rho \frac{{n}^{2} - {2n} + 2}{{\left( n - 2\right) }^{2}}}\right) \operatorname{tr}{\left( H\right) }^{2}
\]

for every pair of orhonormal vectors \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2}}\right\} \) , where \( {H}_{0} \) denotes the tracefree part of \( H \) .

Lemma 4.8 (Lemma A. 8 of [Bre19]) Let \( S \) be an algebraic curvaure tensor, and let \( H \) be a symmetric bilinear form on \( {\mathbb{R}}^{n} \) such that

\[
Z \mathrel{\text{ := }} {S}_{1313} + {\lambda }^{2}{S}_{1414} + {S}_{2323} + {\lambda }^{2}{S}_{2424} - {2\lambda }{S}_{1234} + \left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \left( {{H}_{11} + {H}_{22}}\right)  \geq  0
\]

for every orthonormal four-frame \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2},{e}_{3},{e}_{4}}\right\} \) and every \( \lambda  \in  \left\lbrack  {0,1}\right\rbrack \) . Moreover, suppose that \( Z = 0 \) for one particular orthonormal four-frame \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2},{e}_{3},{e}_{4}}\right\} \) and one particular \( \lambda  \in  \lbrack 0,1) \) . Then, for this particular orthonormal four-frame \( \left\{  {{e}_{1},{e}_{2},{e}_{3},{e}_{4}}\right\} \) and this \( \lambda  \in  \lbrack 0,1) \) , we have

\[
Q{\left( S\right) }_{1313} + {\lambda }^{2}Q{\left( S\right) }_{1414} + Q{\left( S\right) }_{2323} + {\lambda }^{2}Q{\left( S\right) }_{2424} - {2\lambda Q}{\left( S\right) }_{1234}
\]

\[
+ {\left( H \land  H\right) }_{1313} + {\lambda }^{2}{\left( H \land  H\right) }_{1414} + {\left( H \land  H\right) }_{2323} + {\lambda }^{2}{\left( H \land  H\right) }_{2424} - {2\lambda }{\left( H \land  H\right) }_{1234}
\]

\[
+ 2\left( {1 - {\lambda }^{2}}\right) \left( {{\left( S \star  H\right) }_{11} + {\left( S \star  H\right) }_{22}}\right)
\]

\[
\geq  \left( {1 + {\lambda }^{2}}\right) {\left( {H}_{11} + {H}_{22}\right) }^{2},
\]

where we define \( {\left( S \star  H\right) }_{ik} = \mathop{\sum }\limits_{{p, q = 1}}^{n}{S}_{ipkq}{H}_{pq} \) .

Proof of Theorem 1.2. Since \( \widetilde{C}\left( {\widetilde{b}}_{\max }\right)  = C\left( {b}_{\max }\right) \) , let \( B = {b}_{\max } + {\widetilde{b}}_{\max } \) , define

\[
\widehat{C}\left( b\right)  = \left\{  \begin{array}{ll} C\left( b\right) , & b \in  \left( {0,{b}_{\max }}\right\rbrack  \\  \widetilde{C}\left( {B - b}\right) , & b \in  \left( {{b}_{\max }, B}\right) . \end{array}\right.
\]

Then \( \widehat{C}\left( b\right) \) is a family of closed, convex, \( O\left( n\right) \) -invariant cones that depends continuously on \( b \in  \left( {0, B}\right) \) . By Theorem 3.3 and Theorem 4.6, for each \( b \in  \left( {0, B}\right) \) , the cone \( \widehat{C}\left( b\right) \) is transversally invariant under the Hamilton ODE.

Moreover, by Definition 3.1, the properties of the family \( C\left( b\right) \) guarantee that there exists a small \( {\beta }_{0} > 0 \) such that

\[
\left( {\{ R : R - \theta \text{ scalid } \land  \mathrm{{id}} \in  {C}_{PIC}\} \cap \left\{  {R : {\operatorname{Ric}}_{11} + {\operatorname{Ric}}_{22} - \theta \text{ scal } + N \geq  0}\right\}  }\right)
\]

\[
\subset  \left\{  {R : R + N\mathrm{{id}} \land  \mathrm{{id}} \in  \widehat{C}\left( {\beta }_{0}\right) }\right\}  .
\]

Now, let \( \left\{  {\beta }_{j}\right\} \) be an increasing sequence such that \( \mathop{\lim }\limits_{{j \rightarrow   + \infty }}{\beta }_{j} = B \) . By Definition 4.1, there exists a sequence of positive reals \( \left\{  {\varepsilon }_{j}\right\} \) with \( \mathop{\lim }\limits_{{j \rightarrow   + \infty }}{\varepsilon }_{j} = 0 \) , and

\[
\widehat{C}\left( {\beta }_{j}\right)  \subset  \left\{  {R : R + {\varepsilon }_{j}\text{ scal }\mathrm{{id}} \land  \mathrm{{id}} \in  {C}_{PIC1}}\right\}  .
\]

This proves Theorem 1.2.
